Mishneh Torah, Tithes 2:
Enno chayyav lehaferish min hattora ella haggomer perotav leachlan leatzmo aval haggomran lemachran patur min hattora vechayyav middivrehem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "asser teasser" vegomer <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta" eno chayyav ella haggomer tevuato leachlah: 
Vechen hallokeach patur min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "tevuat zarecha". vechayyav middivrehem. bamme devarim amurim beshellekachan achar shennigmeru melachtan beyad mocher. aval im nigmeru beyad lokeach chayyav leasser min hattora: 
Perot sheenan reuyim laachila mikkatnan kegon habboser vechayyotze bo enan chayyavin bemaaser ad sheyyigdelu veyeasu ochel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz" ad sheyyihye peri. vechen hattevua vehakkitniyyot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "et kol tevuat zarecha" ad shettease tevua vezo hi onat hammaasrot. vekodem shettaggia hattevua vehapperot leona zo muttar leechol mehen kol ma sheyyirtze uvechol derech sheyyirtze: 
Perot shehen reuyin laachila bekatnan kegon hakkishshuim vehammelaffonot sheen mannichin otan ella kede lehosif begufan bilvad aval reuyin hen mittechilla laachila. hare ellu chayyavin bemaaser bekatnan. shemmittechillat yetziatan bau leonat hammaasrot: 
E zo hi onat hammaasrot. mishsheyyaggiu happerot lehazeria velitzmoach hakkol lefi ma shehu happeri. ketzad. hatteenim mishsheyyeasu rakkim ad sheyyehu reuyim laachila achar 24 shaot mishsheat asifatan. haanavim vehabbeushim vehem haanavim haddakkim hammidbariyyot mishsheyyerae hachartzan shellahem mibbachutz. harimmonim mishsheyyimmas happerach shellahen ben haetzbaot veyetze mimmennu mayim. hattemarim mishsheyyippatchu kisor. haafarsekin mishsheyyattilu gidim adummim. haegozim mishsheyyitparesh haochel mehakkelippa hachitzona. hashshekedim hammetukim mishshettitparesh kelippatan hachitzona. hammarim peturin leolam. ushear kol baale kelippot kegon haitzterubbolin vehallot vehabbatnim mishsheyyaasu kelippa hattachtona hassemucha laochel. hazzetim mishsheyyaasu shemen echad mittisha mimma shehen reuyin laasot kesheyyiggamru. veze shelish shellahen. hattappuchim vehaetrogim mishsheyyitaggelu mippene shehen reuyin laachila keshehem ketannim. hattutim vehaog mishsheyyaadimu. vechen kol sheddarkan lehaadim mishsheyyaadimu. hecharuvin mishsheyyeasu nekuddot nekuddot shechorot. vechen kol sheddarkan lehashechir mishsheyyinnakdu. haagassim vehakerusetmalin vehapperishim vehaozradin mishsheyyeasu karachot karachot levanot. vechen kol sheddarkan lelabben mishsheyyikrechu karachot. hattevua mishshettavi shelish. hattiltan mishshettihye zarah rauy litzmicha im nizra. uveyarak hakkishshuin vehaddeluin vehaavattichin vehammelaffonot vechol kayyotze bahen chayyavin bekatnan kemo shebbearnu. ushear hayyarak sheeno rauy laachila ad sheyyagdil eno chayyav ad sheyyehe rauy laachila. eshkol shehiggia bo afillu gargir yechidi kullo chibbur lemaasrot ucheillu higgia kullo. velo oto eshkol bilvad ella kol haruach sheyyesh bah otah haggefen sheyyesh bah haeshkol. vechen rimmon shehiggia bah afillu pereda achat kullah chibbur: 
Lo yimkor adam perotav mishshebbau leonat hammaasrot lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot. veim bikkeru notel et habbikkurot umuttar limkor hashshear sheadayin lo higgia leonat hammaasrot. vechen lo yimkor adam et gifto veet zaggav lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot lehotzi mehen mashkin. shehammashkin hayyotzin mehem chayyavin bemaasrot. velo et tivno lilkot mimmennu tevua lemi sheeno neeman shehattevua shettillaket min hatteven chayyevet bemaaser: 
Shimre yayin shennatan alehem mayim vesinnenan im natan shelosha umatza arbaa motzi maaser mizze hayyeter mimmakom acher. veeno mafrish alav teruma shehattorem battechilla belibbo al hakkol kemo shebbearnu bitruma. matza pachot mearbaa af al pi shemmatza yeter al middato veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen taam yayin patur: 
Hammakdish perotav keshehen mechubbarin ad shello bau leonat hammaaser ufedaan veachar sheppedaan higgiu chayyavin bemaaser. veim bau leonat hammaasrot vehem beyad haggizbar veachar kach pedaan peturin:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 3: Perot shehiggiu leonat hammaasrot venitleshu vaadayin lo nigmera melachtan kegon tevua shekketzarah vedashah vaadayin lo zara otah velo merchah muttar leechol mehen achilat aray ad shettiggamer melachtan. umishshettiggamer melachtan asur leechol mehen aray:
Bamme devarim amurim begomer perotav lemachran bashshuk. aval im hayta kavvanato leholichan babbayit hare ze muttar leechol mehen aray achar shennigmera melachtan ad sheyyikkavu lemaaser:
Echad mishshishsha devarim kovea happerot lemaasrot. hechatzer. vehammikkach. vehaesh. vehammelach. vehatteruma. vehashshabbat. vechullan en kovin ella bedavar shennigmera melachto:

Ketzad. perot sheddato leholichan labbayit af al pi shennigmera melachtan ochel mehen achilat aray ad shennichnesu labbayit. nichnesu labbayit nikbeu lemaasrot veasur leechol mehen ad sheyyeasser. vechen im mecharan o bishshelan beur o kevashan bemelach o hifrish mehen teruma o nichnesa shabbat alehem lo yochal ad sheyyeasser af al pi shello higgiu labbayit. hichnisan labbayit kodem shettiggamer melachtan hare ze ochel mehen aray. hitchil ligmor melachtan meachar shennichnesu labbayit chayyav leasser hakkol. ketzad. hichnis kishshuin vediluin labbayit kodem sheyyeshafshef mishsheyyatchil leshafshef achat nikbeu hakkol lemaaser. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen hattorem perot shello nigmera melachtan muttar leechol mehen aray. chutz mikkalkalat teenim sheim teramah kodem shettigmor melachtan nikbea lemaaser:

Hammevi levayit sukke teena uvahem teenim. michbede temara uvahem temarim. im hichnisum tinokot o poalim lo nikbeu lemaaser. veim hichnisan baal habbayit chayyav bemaaser. hichnis shibbolim laasot mehen issa lo nikbeu. leachlan melilot nikbeu lemaaser. bamme devarim amurim bitvua. aval bekitniyyot lo nikbeu lemaaser:

Muttar lehaarim al hattevua lehachenisah bemotz kede shettihye behemto ochelet ufetura min hammaaser. vezore meat meat achar shehichnis leveto ufatur leolam min hatteruma umin hammaasrot shehare eno matchil ligmor hakkol:
Haggomer perotav shel chavero shello middato vechen hakkovea perotav beechad min hashshishsha devarim shekkovim lemaaser shello middato hare ellu tavlu lemaaser:

E zehu gemar melachtan shel perot. hakkishshuin vehaddiluin vehaavattichin mishsheyyeshafshef beyado veyasir hatztzihuv shealehen kemo sear dak. veim eno meshafshef mishsheyyaamid arema. uvaavattiach mishsheyyasdir oto bemuktze avattiach betzad avattiach. haya meshafshef achat achat kevan sheggamar kol tzarko nigmera melachtan. vetormin kishshuin vediluin af al pi shello hesir hatztzihuv mealehen:
Hayyarak hanneegad mishsheyyeegod. im eno oged mishsheyyemalle et hakkeli. [im] eno memalle hare ze ochel aray ad sheyyelakket kol tzarko:
Kalkala mishsheyyechappe happerot shebbah bealim uvehutzin vechayyotze bahen. im eno mechappe mishsheyyemalle et hakkeli. im eno memalle ad sheyyelakket kol tzarko:

Keli gadol sheddato lemalleot et chetzyo kevan shemmille chetzyo nitbal. haya bedato lemalleot et kullo eno nitbal ad sheyyemalle et kullo. hayu shenayim uvedato lemalleot et shenehem lo nitbelu ad sheyyemalle shenehem:

Agad hayyarak eged gadol bassade af al pi shebbedato leagdo aguddot ketannot lashshuk hare ze nitbal. happered vehatztzimmukin vehecharuvin mishsheyyaamid arema berosh gaggo. vehabbetzalim mishsheyyasir healim vehakkelippot sheddarko lehashelicham mealehen. veim eno mesir ad sheyyaamid arema:

Hattevua mishsheyyemareach. vee zehu memareach ze hameyappe pene hakkeri shel tevua berachat besof kol davar kederech sheosin kesheggomrin kol maaseha. im eno memareach ad sheyyaamid arema. hakkitniyyot mishsheyyichbor venotel mittachat hakkevara veochel. [im] eno kover ad sheyyemareach. veaf al pi shemmereach muttar littol min hakkuteim umin hatztzedadin umimma shebbetoch hatteven veochel:

Hayyayin mishsheyyannichennu bechaviyyot veyishle hazzaggin vehachartzanin meal pi hechavit. aval keshehu betoch habbor kesheyyagbihennu lehaamido bechavit shote aray vekolet min haggat haelyona umin hatztzinnor umikkol makom veshote:

Hashshemen mishsheyyered lauka af al pi sheyyarad notel min haekel umin hammemel umibben happassin venoten likara ketanna uletamchuy letoch hattavshil af al pi shehu cham mippene sheeno mitbashshel bichli sheni. veim haya cham beyoter kede sheyyichve et hayyad lo yitten letocho mippene shehu mitbashshel:

Haiggul shel devela mishsheyachlikkennu. haggerogarot mishsheyyadush. veim hichnisam limgura mishsheyyaagil beyado al pi hammegura. haya dash haggerogarot bechavit o haiggul al pi hammegura [nishbera hechavit o shenniftecha hammegura] hare ze lo yochal ad sheyyeasser:
Teenim vaanavim shebbammuktze muttar leechol mehen aray bimkoman. aval im natal min hammuktze veholich lemakom acher lo yochal mehen aray shehare nigmera melachtan af al pi shello yavshu kol tzarkan:
Hecharuvin ad shello kinnesan lerosh haggag morid mehen livhema ufatur. mippene shehu machazir et hammotar leyabbesho venimtza maachil aray:

Maaser rishon shehikdimu beshibbolim asur leechol mimmennu aray kodem sheyyafrish terumato veim achal makkin oto makkat mardut. ketzad hi achilat aray. kegon shehaya mekallef seorim veochel mekallef achat achat. veim killef vechanas letoch yado chayyav leasser. haya molel melilot shel chittim menappe miyyad leyad veochel. veim nippa letoch cheko chayyav leasser veen tzarich lomar im nippa bichli sheen ze aray. vechen notel min hayyayin venoten likara letoch tavshil tzonen veochel. aval lo letoch hakkedera af al pi shehi tzonenet mippene shehi kevor katan. vechen sochet zetim al besaro aval lo letoch yado. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ucheshem shemmuttar leechol aray mipperot shello nigmera melachtan kach muttar lehaachil mehen lechayya velivhema velaofot kol ma sheyyirtze umafkir mehen kol ma sheyyirtze kodem sheyyeasser. veim gamru af al pi shello nikbeu lemaaser lo yafkir. velo yaachil livhema ulechayya uleofot achilat keva ad sheyyeasser. umuttar lehaachil livhema aray min hattevel vaafillu betoch habbayit. umaachil pekie amir ad sheyyaasem chavilot:

Hammotze ketzitzot badderech afillu betzad sede ketzitzot hare ellu peturin min hammaaser. matza gerogarot im darsu rov haggerogarot rov haadam chayyav leasser. shechezkatan middavar shennigmera melachtan. vechen im matza pilche devela sheyyadua shehem middavar haggamur:

Matza kerichot birshut hayyachid chayyav leasser. birshut harabbim peturot. vehaalummot bechol makom chayyavot bemaaser. matza tevua merucha ose terumot umaasrot al perot acherot veeno choshesh. matza kalkala mechuppa chayyevet bemaasrot. matza kalkala bemakom sheharov machnisin lashshuk asur leechol mimmenna aray umetakkenah demay. uvemakom sheharov machnisin labbattim ochel mimmenna aray umetakkenah vadday. mechetza lemechetza demay. veim hichnisah labbayit metakkenah vadday. bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen lo gemar melacha. aval bedavar sheyyesh lo gemar melacha af al pi shehu maaser vadday eno tzarich lehaferish teruma. shechezkatan shehifrish mehen teruma beshaa shennigmera melachtan:
Chadre hannemalim shellanu betzad haarema hachayyevet hare hannimtza bahen chayyav lemaasrot sheyyadua shemmiddavar gamur hayu gorrin kol hallayla:

Hammotze zetim tachat hazzayit vecharuvin tachat hecharuv chayyavin bemaaser shechezkatan shemmeilan ze naflu. matza teenim tachat hatteena hare hem safek shehare mishtannot umitlachlechot beafar shemma mitteena zo naflu o mitteenim shennitasseru:

Hammakdish perot telushin ufedaan kodem shettiggamer melachtan chayyav leasser. veim nigmera melachtan beyad hahekdesh veachar kach pedaan peturin min hammaasrot shebbishat chovatan hayu peturin min hammaasrot. hammakdish kama limnachot petura min hammaasrot:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 4: En hattevel nikba lemaasrot min hattora ad sheyyachnisennu leveto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit". vehu sheyyachnisennu derech hashshaar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "veachlu visharecha". aval im hichnis tevuato derech gaggot vekarpifot patur min hatteruma umin hammaasrot:

Yerae li sheen lokin min hattora al achilat hattevel ad sheyyikava bichnisato leveto kemo shebbearnu mippi hashshemua. aval im nikba bishar hashshishsha devarim shemmaninu en lokin alav ella makkat mardut middivrehen. vechen haochel mipperot sheddato leholichan lashshuk achar shennigmera melachtan eno loke ella makkat mardut kemo shebbearnu. sheen haggomer limkor chayyav bemaaser ella middivrehem:

Bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot eno kovea vechen haggaggim enan kovin af al pi shehabbayit shellematta kovea. veim lo haya baggag arba ammot al arba ammot kegon shehaya habbayit meshuppa veole eno poter min hammaaser ella hare gag ze kemiktzat avir habbayit:

Hatztzerifin vehabburganin uvatte hakkayitz vehu arbaa ammudim vetikra al gabbehen shennimtza belo ketalim vechen sukkot sheosin bene hakkeramim uvene hagginnot bime hakkayitz af al pi sheddarin bahen kol yeme hakkayitz veyesh bahem rechayim vetarnegolin enan kovin lemaaser. vechen sukkat hayyotzrim hachitzona vesukkat hechag bechag enan kovin shekkol ellu en diratan keva:
Hatztzerifin vehabburganin tovlin levalehen af al pi sheenan tovlin lechol adam vechen bet hassefer uvet hammidrash tovel leze sheyyoshev umelammed mippene shehem keveto veen tovlin laacherim:
Bet hakkeneset uvet hammidrash im yesh bahen bet dira kovin veim lav en kovin. haoriarot haotzarot shebbassadot haasuyot limchunnas enan kovin veim hayu ledira kovin:
Keshem shehabbayit kovea lemaaser kach hechatzer kovaat lemaaser. umishsheyyikkansu lechatzer derech hashshaar nikbeu af al pi shello hichnisan letoch habbayit:

E zo hi chatzer hakkovaat. kol shehakkelim nishmarin betochah. o sheen adam bosh milleechol betochah. o chatzer sheim yikkanes adam lah omrin lo ma atta mevakkesh. vechen chatzer sheyyesh bah shene diyyurin o shehi lishne shuttafin sheechad potchah venichnas veechad ba venichnas o yotze venoel hoil vehen potchin venoalin hare zo kovaat:
Bet shaar shel chatzer vehaachsadra vehammirpeset hare hen kechatzer im hayta kovaat kovin veim lav enan kovin:
Shete chatzerot zo lefanim mizzo shetehen kovot. sukkat hayyotzrim zo lefanim mizzo happenimit kovaat vehachitzona enah kovaat vehachanut kovaat kevayit:
Hammolich perotav mimmakom lemakom af al pi shehu nichnas bahen levattim velachatzerot badderech lo nikbeu ella ochel aray ad sheyyaggia lemakom shehu sof megammato vechen bachazara:
Harochlin hammachzirin baayarot shehen nichnasin mechatzer lechatzer ochlin aray ad shemmaggiin levayit shellanin bo:

Hammevi teenim min hassade leachlan bechatzer happetura min hammaasrot. shachach vehichnisan letoch beto hare ze muttar lehotzian veleechol mehen aray vechen im shachach veheelan laggag ochel mehen baggag aray. hevian leachlan berosh gaggo veshachach vehichnisan letoch chatzar chavero nikbeu velo yochal ad sheyyeasser:

Chatzer shehi nederet hare hi keginna veochlin betochah aray. vehu sheyyeader rubbah. veim zara rubbah en ochlin aray vechen im nata rubbah. veim nata lenoy chatzer hoil vehi nederet hare ze ochel aray meotan ilanot:

Teena haomedet bechatzer ochel mimmenna achat achat ufatur. veim tzeref chayyav bemaaser. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya omed bakkarka. aval im ala lerosh hatteena memalle cheko veochel sham sheen avir chatzer kovea lemaaser:

Hayta omedet bechatzer venota leginna hare ze ochel mimmenna bagginna kedarko keillu hayta netua bagginna. hayta netua bagginna venota lechatzer hare zo kintua bechatzer sheeno ochel sham ella achat [achat]:

Gefen shennetua bechatzer lo yittol et kol haeshkol veyochal ella megarger echad echad. vechen berimmon lo yittol et kol harimmon ella poret et harimmon bailan veochel happered mishsham. vechen baavattiach kofto bakkarka veochlo sham. haya ochel beeshkol bagginna venichnas min hagginna lechatzer af al pi sheyyatza min hechatzer lo yigmor ad sheyyeasser:
Kusbar hazzerua bechatzer mekarsem ale ale veochlo. veim tzeref chayyav leasser. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 5: Halokeach perot telushin leachlan nikbeu lemaaser middivrehem kemo shebbearnu. umeematay yikavu. mishsheyyitten et haddamim af al pi shello mashach. hare shello natan damim vehaya borer umanniach borer umanniach afillu kol hayyom kullo veaf al pi sheggamar belibbo likkach lo nitchayyev leasser. veim haya yere shamayim mishsheggamar belibbo measser veachar kach yachazir lammocher im ratza lehachazir:
Hallokeach bimchubbar lakkarka o shellakach talush lishloach lachavero lo nikbeu veyesh lo leechol mehen aray:

Haomer lachavero he lecha isar ze veten li bo chamesh teenim hare ze ochel achat achat ufatur. veim tzeref chayyav leasser. he lecha isar ze beesrim teenim sheavor li. borer achat achat veochel. beeshkol sheavor li megarger mimmennu bailan veochel. berimmon sheavor li porto bailan veochel. baavattiach sheavor li kofet bakkarka veochel. veim katzatz et hatteenim vetzerfam o shekkitztzetz haeshkol o haavattiach. chayyav leasser. shehare lo kana ella hannitlash. aval im amar lo he lecha isar bishte teenim ellu bishne eshkolot ellu bishne rimmonim ellu bishne avattichim ellu kotzetz kedarko veochel aray ufatur shello nikbeu bemikkach shehare lekachan bimchubbar:

Hammachalif im chavero ze leechol veze leechol shenehen nikbeu lemaasrot shehare lakchu betalush. ze liktzot veze liktzot shenehen lo nikbeu sheen hammecher kovea davar shello nigmera melachto kemo shebbearnu. lakach haechad perot shehechelif laachila velakach haacher chalifehen lehaketzotan. ze shellakach laachila chayyav leasser. veze shellakach lehaketzotan lo nikba lammaaser:
Haomer lachavero tze velakket lecha esrim teenim mishshelli vaani amalle et keresi mishshellecha shenehem peturim sheen ze chalifin kede sheyyihye mecher. veim tzeref veachal chayyav:

Vehammattana enah kovaat kemecher. am haaretz shehaya over bashshuk veamar telu lachem teenim ochlim ufeturin sheen hammattana kovaat. veim hichnisu levattehen im rov haam machnisim labbattim measserim vadday. veim rov haam machnisim lashshuk en metakkenim ella demay shemma isser veachar kach hevi lashshuk. veim amar telu lachem vehachenisu labbattim keshemmachnis labbayit measser demay. natan lo davar merubbe afillu amar lo tol veechol hare ze kemi sheamar lo tol vehachenes sheeno ochel ad sheyyetakken demay. vechen im natan lo davar sheen darko leheachel chay o shehaya adam gadol sheen darko leechol bashshuk hare ze metakken demay:
Hayu shenayim amar leechad tol veechol veamar lesheni tol vehachenes ze ochel ufatur veze ochel vechayyav:

Vechen anashim shehayu yoshvim bashshaar o bachanut veamar lahem telu veichlu hare ellu ochlin ufeturin. uvaal hashshaar o baal hachanut lo yochal ad sheyyeasseru demay. shennimtza keomer leellu telu vehachenisu levattechem shehare hem kevattehem. uchevar bearnu sheen habbayit sheeno shello kovea lo kesheyyaavru happerot betocho:

Hassocher et happoalim laasot immo beferot ben bitlushin ben bimchubbarin hoil veyesh lahem leechol min hattora bema shehen osin hare ellu ochlin ufeturim min hammaaser. veim hitna immahen sheyyochlu ma shello zachta lahen tora kegon shehitna immahen happoel sheyyochlu banav immo o sheyyochal beno bischaro o sheyyochal achar gemar melachto betalush hare ze asur leechol ad sheyyeasser hoil veochel mippene hattenay hare ze kelokeach:
Secharo lenakkesh immo bezetim vehitna happoel sheyyochal bezetim hare ze ochel min hailan achat achat ufatur veim tzeref chayyav:

Secharo lenakkesh bivtzalim vehitna leechol yarak mekarsem ale ale veochel veim tzeref chayyav. katzatz happoel sheyyochal litra shel zetim ochel achat achat veim tzeref chayyav leasser hoil vehu ochel davar katzuv hare ze kelokeach sheim tzeref nikba. lo kitztzetz ella haya ochel kedin tora. metzaref veochel kol ma sheyyirtze vehu shello yispot bemelach. aval im safat bemelach achat achat muttar shetayim shetayim asur shehare nikbeu [bemelach]:
Poel shehaya ose bilvasin lo yochal bivnot sheva. bivnot sheva lo yochal ballevasin ad sheyyeasser. aval yesh lo limnoa atzmo ad sheyyaggia limkom hayyafot:

Hammotzi poalim laasot lo melacha bassade bizman sheen lahen alav mezonot ochlin mipperot shebbassade ufeturin min hammaaser vehu shello nigmera melachtan. aval im yesh lahen alav mezonot lo yochlu veaf al pi shello nigmera melachtan sheen porin chov min hattevel. aval ochlin achat achat min hatteena aval lo min hassal velo min hkuppa velo min hammuktze:
Echad hamevashshel veechad hashsholek veechad hakkovesh kovea lemaaser. aval hameashshen et happerot ad shehichshiran hare ze safek:
Hattomen perot baadama o batteven o bazzevel ad shehichshiran laachila lo nikbeu lemaaser:

Hannoten yayin letavshil cham o shennatan shemen likdera beilfas keshehen meruttachin nikbeu lemaaser. mazag yayin bemayim chammim nikba. veen tzarich lomar im bishshel hayyayin vaafillu begat sheasur lishtot mimmennu ad sheyyeasser:
Hashshum vehashshachalim vehachardal sheshshechakan bassade beshemen nitbelu lemaaser. vechen hassochet eshkol letoch hakkos nikba. letoch hattamchuy eno nikba:

Hammoleach perot bassade nikbeu. taval hazzetim echad echad bemelach veachal patur. happotzea zetim kede sheyyetze hassaraf mehem patur. hannotel zetim min hammaatan tovel echad echad bemelach veochel. veim malach venatan lefanav chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Hattorem perotav teruma shetztzarich litrom achareha sheniyya nikbeu lemaaser. velo yochal mehen aray ad sheyyotzi hatteruma hashsheniyya viasser:
Perot shennigmera melachtan vechashcha alehen lele shabbat nikbeu velo yochal mehen afillu leachar hashshabbat ad sheyyeasser:
Tinokot shettamnu teenim leshabbat veshachchu leasseran lo yeachlu lemotzae shabbat ad sheyyeasseru:
Teena shehayta meyuchedet lo leechol peroteha beshabbat velikket mimmenna kalkala lo yochal ad sheyyeasser hoil uferot ellu meyuchadin leshabbat vehashshabbat kovaat:
Haya ochel beeshkol vechashcha alav lele shabbat lo yigmor achilato beshabbat ad sheyyeasser. veim hinnichan leachar shabbat hare ze gomro:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 6: Machlikin bitenim vaanavim shel tevel veen baze mishshum hefsed. vechol sheasur lezarim leachlo bitruma kegon haggarinin vechayyotze bahen kach asur leachlo min hattevel umin hammaaser shello nittela terumato umimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. vechol shemmuttar lezarim leachlo bitruma middevarim ellu kach muttar betevel uvemaaser shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu:

En madlikin betevel tame afillu bechol veen tzarich lomar beshabbat shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 8)</small> "et mishmeret terumotay" ma teruma tehora en lecha bah ella mishsheat haramatah af teruma temea en lecha lehanot bah ella mishsheat haramatah veelach:

En mechappin betevel veen zorin et hattevel vaafillu perot shello nigmera melachtan asur lizroa mehen ad sheyyeasser. bamme devarim amurim bitvua vekitniyyot vechayyotze bahen. aval haoker shetilim sheyyesh bahen perot mimmakom lemakom betoch sadehu hare ze muttar veeno kezorea tevel shehare lo asaf happerot. vechen haoker lefet utzenonot ushetalam bemakom acher im nitkavven lehosif begufan muttar. veim shetalan kede sheyyekashshu veyikkach hazzera shellahen asur mippene shehu kezorea chittim o seorim shel tevel:

Litra maaser tavul shezzeraah vehishbichah vahare hi eser litrin chayyevet bemaaser. veotah litra measser aleha mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon. litra betzalim shettikkenam uzeraam eno measser lefi cheshbon hattosefet ella measser lefi kullo:

Zeronim sheheviu shelish umerachan veisseran veachar kach zeraan vehosifu veen zaram kale hare ze safek im chayyavin bemaaser middivrehem hoil vehosifu. o en chayyavin shehare hazzera sheadayin hu kayyam velo avad meussar hu. veen ellu domim livtzalim shehabbetzalim en darkan lehizzara:

Hazzorea et hattevel ben davar shezzaro kale ben davar sheen zaro kale im efshar lelakto konsin oto umelakketo. veim tzamach en mechayyevin oto laakor vehaggiddulin chullin. veim haya davar sheen zaro kale afillu giddule giddulin asurin ad shalosh goranot veharvii muttar. umippene ma haggiddulin asurin mippene terumat maaser uteruma gedola shebbah. vechen haddin bezorea maaser shello nittela terumato. en mochrin et hattevel ella letzorech ulechaver. veasur lishloach et hattevel vaafillu chaver lechaver shemma yismechu ze al ze veyeachel hattevel:

Hammocher perot lachavero venizkar shehem tevel veratz acharav letakkeno velo metzao. im yadua sheen kayyamin veshekkevar avdu o neechlu eno tzarich leasser alehem. veim safek shehem kayyamin o en kayyamin tzarich lehotzi alehen maasrot mipperot acherot:
Hammocher perot lachavero mocher omer al menat shehen tevel macharti. velokeach omer lo lakachti mimmecha ella meessarin. kofin et hammocher letakken. kenas hu lo mippene shemmachar tevel:
En porin chov min hattevel mippene shehu kemochro:
Mi shellakchu bet hammelech et perotav vehem tevalim. im mechamat shehu chayyav lahen tzarich lehotzi alehen maasrot. veim lakchu beones eno tzarich leasser alehem:

Hallokeach tevel mishshene mekomot measser mizze al ze. hamekabbel sade miyyisrael o min hannachri cholek venoten levaal hassade befanav kede sheyyeda shettevel natal. aval hachocher sade miyyisrael im natan lo mizzera otah sade torem veachar kach noten lo mizzo shekkatzatz litten lo uvaal hassade measser leatzmo. veim natan lo mizzera sade acheret o mimmin acher motzi hammaaser veachar kach noten lo:

Hachocher sade min haakkum measser veachar kach noten lo. kenas kenasuhu baze kede shello yachkor min haakkum, venimtzet hassade bura lefanav ad sheyyitztarech veyimkerenna leyisrael. vechen hamekabbel sede avotav min haakkum kenasuhu sheyyeasser veachar kach yitten chelko leakkum meussar kede shello yikpotz vikabbelah mimmennu mippene shehi sede avotav ad shettishshaer lefanav bura kede sheyyimkerenna leyisrael:

E zehu chocher vee zehu mekabbel. chocher shechocher hakkarka bedavar katzuv min hazzera bechach vechach sea ben asta harebe ben asta meat. mekabbel hu sheyyekabbel otah bechelek mimma shettease chetzyo o shelisho o ma sheyyittenu benehen. socher hu shessocher hakkarka bemaot:

Shenayim shekkibbelu sade baarisut o yarshu o nishtattefu yachol haechad lomar lachavero tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni. aval lo yomar tol atta chittim vaani seorim atta yayin vaani shemen mippene shemmochrin et hattevel:

Kohen o levi shellakchu perot miyyisrael achar shennigmera melachtan motziin et hatteruma vehammaasrot midehen venotnin otam lechohanim velilviyyim acherim. kenas hu lahem kede shello yikpetzu logoranot ulegittot veyiknu tevalim kede lehafekia mattenot achehem hakkohanim. veim kanu kodem shettiggamer melachtan en motziim miyyadam:

Kohen o levi shemmachru perot telushin leyisrael kodem shettiggamer melachtan veen tzarich lomar im machru bimchubbar hare hatteruma o hammaaser shellahem. veim machru achar gemar melacha hare hatteruma vehammaaser shel lokeach umafrish venoten lechol kohen o levi sheyyirtze:

Kohen velevi shekkibbelu sade miyyisrael keshem shecholkin bechullin kach cholkin bitruma uvemaasrot vehayyisrael notel chelko venoten lechol kohen o levi sheyyirtze. aval yisrael shekkibbel sade mikkohen o millevi hatteruma o hammaaser levaal hassade ushear hammattanot cholkin:
Hamekabbel zetim lehotzi mehen shemen ben yisrael mikkohen o levi ben kohen o levi miyyisrael keshem shecholkin bechullin kach cholkin bitruma umaasrot mippene shehashshemen chashuv hu:

Kohen shemmachar sade leyisrael veamar lo al menat shehammaaser shellah shelli leolam hare hen shello kevan sheamar al menat naase kemi sheshshiyyer mekom hammaaser. veim met hakkohen hare beno kishar hakkohanim. veim amar lo al menat shehammaasrot li velivni met hu yitlem beno. al menat shehammaasrot shelli kol zeman shehi lefanecha mecharah leacher af al pi shechazar ulekachah en lakkohen otam hammaasrot:

Yisrael shekkibbel sade mikkohen velevi veamar lo al menat shehammaasrot shelli arba o chamesh shanim muttar. al menat shehen shelli leolam asur sheen kohen ose kohen. vechen ben levi shehaya alav chov leyisrael lo yihye yisrael ze gove meacherim umafrish ad sheyyifra keneged chovo sheen levi ze ose baal chov shello kelevi acher sheyyigbe maaser meacherim:

Yisrael sheyyarash tevel memorach meavi immo kohen veoto avi immo yerasho meavi immo yisrael hare ze mafrish mimmennu maasrotav vehen shello. shehammattanot haruyot litarem kemo shehuremu hen af al pi shello huremu:

Hannoten sadehu bekabbala leakkum o lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot af al pi shello bau leonat maasrot tzarich leasser al yadam. netanah leam haaretz ad shello bau leonat hammaasrot eno tzarich leasser al yadam. umishshebbau leonat hammaasrot tzarich leasser al yadam. ketzad hu ose. omed al haggoren venotel veeno choshesh lema sheachlu sheen anu achrain lahem:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 7:
Mi shehayu lo mea log shel yayin tavul min hattora veamar shene login sheani atid lehaferish mehen hare hen teruma vaasara maaser rishon vetisha maaser sheni. lo yatchil veyishte ad sheyyanniach besof shiur teruma umaasrot. ella yafrish veachar kach yishte. veen omrin ze shehinniach bassof keillu nivrar techilla mippene shechiyyuv teruma umaasrot min hattora veen omrin beshel tora nachshov keillu nivrar ad sheyyivror: 
Hakkovea maasrotav befi hechavit lo yishte mishshuleha. beshuleha lo yishte mippiha. mippene shehammashkin meoravin. aval hakkovea befi hammegura ochel mishshuleha. kava beshuleha ochel mippiha: 
Veyesh laadam likboa maaser sheni ufodehu veosehu maaser rishon al otan happerot o terumat maaser lemakom acher: 
Hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehen maasrot mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin veochel veshote ad sheyyeasu kol otan happerot shehinniach maaser venoten lallevi. metzaan sheavdu hare ze choshesh lechol shehifrish veeno measser vadday: 
Hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani lihyot mafrish al otan hammaot mechelko mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin veeno choshesh shemma metu hakkohen o hallevi o heeshir heani: 
Ketzad mafrish alehen. mafrish teruma o maaser rishon o maaser sheni mipperotav umezakke bahen al yede acher leoto kohen o hallevi o heani shehilvum. veim hayu regilin littol mimmennu vehu ragil shello yitten ella lahen eno tzarich lezakkot al yede acher. veachar shemmafrish mechashshev kamma shave ze shehifrish umenakke min hammilve ad sheyyifra kol chovo umocher hatteruma lechol kohen sheyyirtze veochel hammaasrot: 
Keshehu mechashshev ma shavim happerot shehifrish yesh lo lechashshev kashshaar hazzol veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit. veen hashsheviit meshammetet chov ze. veim ba baal habbayit lachazor eno chozer. aval im ratzu ellu shellakchu hammaot lachazor chozrin. nityaashu mehen habbealim en mafrishin alehen sheen mafrishin al haavud. met hakkohen o hallevi o heani shehilvum eno yachol lehaferish alehen mechelkan kadderech hazzo ad sheyyittol reshut min hayyorshin. vehu sheyyanniach lahen karka afillu melo machat. aval im hinniach kesafim en reshut hayyoresh moelet. veim hilvam bevet din al menat sheyyafrish al maot ellu mechelkam eno tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshin. heeshir heani en mafrishin alav af al pi shehilvuhu bevet din zoche halla bema shebbeyado: 
Yisrael sheamar leven levi kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi rashshay ben levi laasoto terumat maaser al makom acher af al pi shello mashach. veim netano hayyisrael lelevi acher en lo alav ella taromet: 
Mi shehayu lo perot bimgura venatan sea lelevi usea leani lo yafrish shemone sein min hammegura veyochlem. ella im ken yodea sheshshete sein shel maasrot kayyamin. aval im achlu mehen hallevi veheani eno mafrish alehen ella lefi cheshbon hannishar mishshete hassein: 
Aniyyim shehechlifu mattenotehen im baal habbayit kegon shennatnu lo sea shel leket o shichcha ufea umaaser ani venatlu sea min haggoren. ze shennatal mehem patur min hammaaser af al pi shennaasa birshut baal habbayit. veze shennatlu mimmennu chayyav af al pi shehu chelef mattenotehen happeturin: 
Mi shehayu lefanav shete kalkalot shel tevel shennittela terumatan veamar maasrot zo bazo harishona meusseret. amar maasrot zo bazo vezo bazo harishona meesseret shehare kava maasroteha bashsheniyya. veen hashsheniyya meesseret sheen mafrishin maaser min harishona shekkevar niftera al hashsheniyya sheadayin hi chayyevet bemaasar shetehen: 
Amar maasrot shete kalkalot ellu maaser kol achat mehen kavua bachavertah kara shem uchevar kava maasrotehen bahen umotzi hammaasrot shellahen veeno yachol lehotzi alehen maasrot mimmakom acher: 
Vechetzad measseran. motzi maasar shetehen meachat mehen o measser kol achat mehen mimmenna im hayu shavot. veim hayta achat gedola mechavertah mafrish min hakketanna maasar haggedola umin haggedola maasar hakketanna:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 8:
Happerot shehuram mehen teruma gedola uterumat maaser hen hannikrain chullin. veim hifrish mehen shear maasrotehen hen hannikrain chullin metukkanin bechol makom: 
Tevel shennitarev bechullin metukkanin min bemino shei efshar lehallech achar hattaam. im yesh lo perot acherot motzi al oto tevel teruma umaasrot lefi cheshbon. veim en lo perot acherot lehotzi al oto tevel hare hakkol asur ad sheyyafrish. ucheshehu mafrish mafsid min hachullin hametukkanin kede terumat maaser shebbattevel: 
Ketzad. mea sea shel tevel shennitarev bemea sea shel chullin metukkanin mafrish min hakkol echad umea. vechol shehifrish tevel veyishshaer 99 chullin metukkanin nimtza mafsid sea achat. vechen im haya oto tevel tavul litruma mafsid min hachullin hametukkanin kede teruma uterumat maaser. velamma mafsid sea zo kede shello yomar mea shehifrish hen mea shel chullin vehammea shennisharu hu hattevel. vechen im haya hattevel pachot min hachullin o merubbe al hachullin magbiah hattevel uchede terumat maaser shebbattevel min hachullin o kede teruma uterumat maaser im haya hattevel tavul litruma: 
Vechen im nitarev maaser tavul bechullin metukkanin oser bechol shehu. im yesh lo maaser acher motzi oto al maaser hattavul terumat maaser lefi cheshbon. veim en lo maaser magbiah hammaaser shennitarev umafsid min hachullin hametukkanin kede terumat maaser shebbamaaser hattavul: 
Ketzad. mea maaser shennitarev bemea chullin metukkanin mafrish min hakkol mea veeser vechol shehifrish maaser vehattishim hannisharot hen chullin keshehayu. vechen im hayu hachullin merubbin al hammaaser hattavul o pechutim mimmennu mafrish hammaaser uchede terumat maaser shebbamaaser hattavul min hachullin: 
Tevel shennitarev bemaaser tavul im haya hattevel kamaaser mafsid min hattevel kede terumat maaser shebbo. ketzad. mea sea tevel shennitarev bemea sea maaser mafrish echad umea veze shehifrish maaser vetishim vetesha hannisharot tevel. haya hattevel merubbe al hammaaser mafrish hammaaser bilvad. velo yafsid min hattevel kelum sheim yikra shem litrumat maaser shennitbal nimtza hammaaser medumma bitrumat maaser shel tevel shealta immo. haya hammaaser merubbe al hattevel kore shem litrumat maaser [shebbattevel] umafrish hattevel uchede terumat maaser shel tivlo echad mimmea min hammaaser veyihye hattevel kullo medumma veyimkerenna lechohen chutz middeme shete terumot shebbo venimtza mafsid min hammaaser echad mimmea shebbo shehu kemo terumat maaser shebbattevel. ketzad. mea tevel im matayim maaser mafrish mea veshalosh vehashshalosh hen terumat maaser shel mea tevel veshiur terumat maaser mimmatayim kede shello yavo litot im nitarvu bichmoto veyishshaer 197 vehem maaser keshehayu: 
Mi shehayu lo eser shurot shel eser eser kadde yayin vekava kad echad mishshura hachitzona maaser al makom acher veen yadua e zo shura hachitzona hi. notel shete chaviyyot baalachson umearev shetehen umafrish mehen: 
Kevaah bachatzi shura hachitzona veen yadua e zo chatzi shura hi notel arba chaviyyot mearba zaviyyot. kevaah beshura achat mehen veen yadua e zo shura hi notel shura achat baalachson. kevaah bachatzi shura veen yadua e zo chatzi shura hi notel shete shurot baalachson shehare natal chavit mikkol chatzi shura umearev umafrish: 
Kava hammaaser bechad achat mehen veen yadua e zo hi notel mikkol kad vechad min hammea umearev umafrish kede kad achat umeasser:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 9: Bime yochanan kohen gadol shehaya achar shimon hatztzaddik shalchu bet din haggadol uvadku bechol gevul yisrael umatzu shehakkol zehirim bitruma gedola umafrishin otah. aval maaser rishon umaaser sheni umaasar ani hayu amme haaretz miyyisrael mekillin al atzman velo hayu mafrishin otan. lefichach gazru shello yehe neeman al hammaasrot ella anashim neemanim. aval amme haaretz perotehen safek veen neemanin lomar meessarin hen. vezehu hannikra demay:

Vehitkinu shello yehe adam mafrish min haddemay ella terumat maaser mippene shehu avon mita. umaaser sheni sheen baze hefsed shehare bealav ochlin oto. aval maaser rishon umaasar ani en mafrish min haddemay mippene shehu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. lefichach omer lallevi o leani have reaya sheeno meessar vetol maasrot:

Af al pi sheen mafrishin maasar ani min haddemay tzarich likrot lo shem veeno mafrish veomer issur ma sheyyesh kan maasar ani kede likboa maaser sheni shemmaasar ani bishlishit veshishshit bimkom maaser sheni shel shear shene hashshavua:
Keshemmafrishin min haddemay terumat maaser umaaser sheni en mevarchin alehen lefi shehu safek. lefichach muttar lehaferish keshehu erom:

Ketzad measserin et haddemay. mafrish kede terumat maaser shehu echad mimmea min hakkol umannichah betzad happerot veomer ze maaser ushear maaser samuch lo. veachar kach omer ze sheamarti alav shehu maaser hare hu terumat maaser al shear hammaaser hassamuch lo. venotel otah venotnah lakkohen sheeno rashshay lehaferish terumat maaser kodem hammaaser lechattechilla. veachar kach mafrish maaser sheni:

Umuttar lehaferish maaser sheni kodem harishon bidmay. veim ratza omer maaser sheni shel perot ellu bitzfonam o bidromam vahare hu mechullal al hammaot. vechen hallokeach kikkar min hannachtom mafrish mimmenna kede terumat maaser vechalla veomer echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan hare hu maaser ushear maaser samuch lo veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al hashshear hassamuch lo vehayyeter al echad mimmea sheyyesh baze shehifrashti hare hu challa umaaser sheni bitzfonah o bidromah vahare hu mechullal al hammaot veochel:

Vechen hammazmin et chavero sheyyochal etzlo vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot omer meerev shabbat ma sheani atid lehaferish lemachar hare hu maaser ushear maaser samuch lo. veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al shear hassamuch lo umaaser sheni bitzfono o bidromo vahare hu mechullal al hammaot. mippene shemmuttar leadam lehatenot tenaim ellu al haddemay af al pi sheeno birshuto. aval bevadday eno matne ella al davar shebbirshuto:

Ketzad. hayu lo mea teenim shel tevel beveto vehu bevet hammidrash o bassade umityare shemma techshach veeno yachol leasser beshabbat omer shene teenim sheani atid lehaferish hare hen teruma. veeser sheani mafrish acharehen maaser rishon. tesha sheani mafrish acharehen maaser sheni. ulemachar mafrish veochel:

Vetzarich lirchosh bisfatav beshaa shemmafrish zo achar zo veeno kimtakken beshabbat shehare hikdim tenao. vetevel sheyyesh alav tenay ze muttar letaltelo beshabbat kodem sheyyafrish. venoten enav betzad ze veochel et hashshear:

Natan lo am haaretz kos lishtoto omer ma sheani atid leshayyer beshule hakkos hare hu maaser ushear maaser samuch lo veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al hashshear hassamuch lo umaaser sheni befi hakkos vahare hu mechullal al hammaot veshote umanniach kede terumat maaser beshule hakkos:

Vechen im zimmeno chavero lishtot beshabbat matne kitnay ze meerev shabbat al kol ma sheyyirtze sheyyisod etzlo. vechen poel sheeno maamin levaal habbayit notel gerogeret achat veomer zo vetesha habbaot achareha asuyot maaser al hammea sheani atid leechol vezo haachat terumat maaser al haeser habbaot achareha umaaser sheni hu haeser haacharonot vahare hu mechullal al hammaot venoten haggerogeret shehifrish lakkohen. vehappoel mafrish leatzmo deme maaser sheni. shettenay bet din hu shettihye terumat maaser mishshel baal habbayit umaaser sheni mishshel poel:

Hannachtomim lo chiyyevum chachamim lehaferish maaser sheni min haddemay ella terumat maaser bilvad kede sheyyafrishenna betohora im hachalla. vehallokeach mafrish maaser sheni. bamme devarim amurim bemocher bachanuto o al petach chanuto. aval hammocher lefalter o bachanut hassemucha lefalter chayyav lehaferish af maaser sheni:

Shenayim shebbatzru karmehen betoch gat achat vehaechad mehem eno neeman al hammaasrot. af al pi sheisser ze hanneeman al chelko keshehu notel chelko min hayyayin chayyav lehaferish mimmennu maaser demay al chelek am haaretz. ketzad. hayu mechetza lemechetza venotel bechetzyo matayim log yayin hare ze mafrish mimmennu log echad terumat maaser veeser maaser sheni keneged hammea log shehare hifrish hammaaser shel vadday techilla al chatzi kol shedderacho baggat. vechen im haya shelish o revia mafrish lefi cheshbon:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 10: Hamekabbel alav lihyot neeman al hammaasrot velo yihyu perotav demay tzarich lihyot measser et shehu ochel veet shehu mocher veet shehu lokeach. veeno mitareach etzel am haaretz. vetzarich sheyyekabbel alav devarim ellu barabbim. uchesheyyavou edim neemanin shekkibbel devarim ellu barabbim veshehu ragil bahem tamid hare ze neeman al perotav lomar meessarin hen:

Kol talmid chacham leolam neeman veeno tzarich bedika acharav. uvanav uvene beto vaavadav [veishto] hare hem kamohu. talmid chacham shemmet vehinniach perot afillu kenasam beoto hayyom hare hen bechezkat metukkanin:

Bat am haaretz o ishto shennisset lechaver veavdo shennimkar lechaver tzerichin lekabbel alehem battechilla. uvat chaver o ishto shennisset leam haaretz veavdo shennimkar leam haaretz hare hen bechezkatan ad sheyyechashdu. beno o avdo shel chaver shehayu lemudin etzel am haaretz tzerichin lekabbel. beno o avdo shel am haaretz shehayu lemudim etzel chaver kol zeman shehen etzlo hare hen kechaver. yatzu hare hen keam haaretz:
Mi sheeno neeman vehaya echad mibbanav o meavadav neeman o echad mimmishpachto lokchin mimmennu veochlin al pihen veenan choshshin ledavar:

Haya hu neeman veishto enah neemenet lokchim mimmennu veen mitarchin etzlo. [hayta ishto neemenet vehu eno neeman mitarchin etzlo veen lokchin mimmennu. vetavo meera lemi sheishto neemenet vehu eno neeman]:

Lo yeshammesh chaver lo bemishte am haaretz velo bisuddato ella im ken haya hakkol meussar umetukkan mittachat yado. lefichach haroe chaver meshammesh bemishte am haaretz o bisuddato hare hakkol bechezkat metukkan umeussar. rauhu mesev im amme haaretz en hasseudda bechezkat meusseret. shemma hechaver al hattenaim shebbelibbo hu somech:

Keshem sheadam soed etzel am haaretz vesomech al tenao kach hu tzarich lihyot matne al beno vaafillu haya beno bemakom acher. aval eno tzarich lihyot matne al acher chutz mibbeno vaafillu haya immo bemishte. lefichach ben chaver shehaya mesev bemishte am haaretz en hasseudda bechezkat meusseret shemma aviv hitna alav:

Am haaretz shennatan maa lechaver veamar lo kach li aguddat yarak achat o geluska achat lokeach lo setam ufatur milleasser. veim hechelif et hammaa chayyav leasser veachar kach yavi lo. veim peresh hechaver velo lekachan setam ella amar lachenvani agudda zo sheani lokeach mimmecha lachaveri ani kone otah vezo leatzmi ani kone otah. zo shellakach leatzmo chayyav leasserah. vezo shellakach lachavero eno tzarich leasserah. veim nitarvu afillu nitarva achat shello bemea shel chavero metakken hakkol demay. veachar kach yitten lachavero sheshshelacho likkach lo:

Chamishsha sheamru leechad tze vehave lanu chamesh aguddot shel yarak. vehevi lechol echad veechad bifne atzmo. chaverim shebbahen en tzerichin leasser ella al chelkan bilvad. hevi lahen beirbuv chaverim shebbahem tzerichin leasser hakkol:

Am haaretz sheamar lechaver tze velakket li teenim mitteenati ochel mehen hechaver aray umeasseran [demay]. veim amar hechaver leam haaretz lilkot lo veshama chaver acher ze haacher ochel veeno tzarich leasser sheen hechaver motzi davar sheeno metukkan mittachat yado vechezkato shehifrish aleha mimmakom acher. af al pi shello nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf, kede lesallek hammichshol millifne am haaretz tormin:
Muttar lehaachil et haaniyyim veet haorchim demay vetzarich lehodian. veheani atzmo vehaoreach im ratzu letakken metakkenin:
Gabbae tzedaka govin setam mikkol adam umechallekim setam veharotze letakken yetakken:

Rofe chaver shehaya maachil lechole am haaretz mipperot am haaretz noten letoch yado aval lo letoch piv. veim haya haddemay shel rofe afillu letoch yado lo yitten. vechen im yada shehu tevel vadday afillu letoch yado asur:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 11:
Asur limkor et haddemoy leam haaretz o lishloach lo demay mippene shehu mesayyea laze leechol davar haasur. aval mochrin umeshallechin oto letalmide chachamim sheen talmid chacham ochel ad sheyyeasser o ad sheyyodio adam neeman shezze meussar: 
Kol hammashpiin bemidda gassa kegon hassitonot umochre tevua muttarin limkor et haddemay uleshallecho. mippene shehen mosifin al hammidda hitkinu chachamim sheyyihye hallokeach o ze shennishtallechu lo hu hammafrish maaser demay. aval hammoddin bemidda dakka hoil vehammocher mistakker hu mafrish velo yimkor velo yishlach ella metukkan: 
Vechamma hi midda gassa. beyavesh chatzi sea uvelach midda shemmachzeket sheve dinar meoto davar hallach: 
Salle zetim vaanavim vekuppot shel yarak af al pi shehu mochran achsara asur lemachran demay: 
Amar echad mehen bo unetakken happerot haellu ben shehaya mocher bedakka o begassa hammocher mafrish terumat maaser vehallokeach mafrish maaser sheni vedavar ze tenay bet din hu: 
Chaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihen am haaretz yachol hu lomar tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni. atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni. aval lo yomar tol atta chittim vaani seorim. tol atta hallach vaani hayyavesh. mippene shezze mocher demay: 
Mi shehaya nose yarak vechaved alav massao veratza lehashelich mimmennu al hadderech kede lehakel mimmassao. lo yashlich ad sheyyeasser. kede shello tehe takkala leamme haaretz sheochlin oto bidmay: 
Hallokeach yarak min hashshuk umashach af al pi shello shakal velo madad velo natan damim venimlach lehachazir levaal hachanut lo yachazir ad sheyyeasser: 
Hammotze perot badderech. im rov machnisin levattehen patur milleasser sheadayin lo nikba lemaaser. veim rov machnisin limkor bashshuk hare ellu demay. umechetza lemechetza demay: 
Netalan leachlan venimlach lehatzenia lo yashhe otan ad sheyyeasser kede shello yihye takkala laacherim. veim netalam mittechilla shello yovdu hare ze muttar lashhotan etzlo ad sheyyirtze leachlan o leshalchan o lemachran viasser otan demay: 
Kenivat yarak hannimtzet bagginna hare zo petura min haddemay. veshel baal habbayit hannimtzet babbayit chayyevet. sheal gabbe haashpa bechol makom mutteret: 
Hannoten lefundakit levashshel lo veleefot lo measser et shehu noten lah kede shello yihye takkala laacherim. umeasser et shehu notel mimmenna mippene shehi chashuda lehachalif shel ze [baze]. aval hannoten lachamoto ben shennasa bittah ben sheersah o lishchento pat leefot vetavshil levashshel eno choshesh lo mishshum maaser velo mishshum sheviit mippene sheenah chashuda lehachalif. bamme devarim amurim bizman shennatan lah seor leisa vetavlin likdera. aval im lo natan choshesh mishshum maasrot vechoshesh mishshum sheviit. ulefichach im hayta shenat shemitta asur shemma hasseor missefiche sheviit hu: 
Hammolich chittav letochen am haaretz hare hen bechezkatan sheeno chashud lehachalif. holichan letochen akkum hare hem demay shemma hechelifan bechittim shel am haaretz. vechen hammafkid etzel am haaretz hare hen bechezkatan sheeno chashud lehachalif happikkadon: 
Am haaretz shehaya mishtammesh bachanuto shel chaver af al pi shehechaver yotze venichnas hare ze muttar veeno choshesh shemma hechelif: 
Hammafkid perotav etzel haakkum hare hen keferotav shel akkum shechezkato lehachalif happikkadon. veheach dinam. im hayu perot sheadayin lo nigmera melachtan venigmeru beyad yisrael achar shellakach happikkadon mafrish maasrotav kemo shebbearnu. veim hayu perot shehifkid tevalim venigmera melachtan chayyav lehaferish shemma lo hechelif haakkum. ulefichach yerae li shehammaasrot sheyyafrish safek. aval im hifkid chullin metukkanin eno tzarich lehaferish kelum sheafillu hechelif haakkum peturin kemo shebbearnu behilchot terumot <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "degancha" velo degan akkum:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 12:
Halokeach perot mimmi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot veshachach leasseran venichnesa shabbat o yom tov sheeno yachol leasser hare ze shoalo. veim amar lo meussarin hen ochel al piv beshabbat. vechen im amar lo echad sheeno neeman meussarin hen ochel al piv beotah shabbat. vaafillu hayu lo perot acherot metukkanin meoto hammin mippene sheemat shabbat al amme haaretz veeno over bah avera: 
Af al pi shehu ochel al piv beshabbat hare ze lo yochal meotan happerot lemotzae shabbat ad sheyyeasser demay al hakkol al sheachal beshabbat veal hannishar shello hekellu veheeminuhu ella letzorech otah shabbat. hayta shabbat veyom tov samuch lah ushealo beechad mehen ochel af bashsheni. mippene shello nire leasser bentayim. vechen bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot: 
Hannishba al chavero sheyyochal immo beshabbat vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot shoel veochel al piv bashshabbat harishona bilvad. aval beshabbat sheniyya af al pi shennadar mimmennu hanaa im lo yochal etzlo lo yochal ad sheyyeasser demay: 
Mi sheeno neeman sherinuhu shehifrish terumat maaser mipperotav shehen demay ureinuhu shechazra venafla befanenu ben lemakom acher ben limkomah vechazar veamar hifrashtiha neeman afillu bechol veochel al piv. keshem sheemat shabbat al amme haaretz kach emat dimmua alehem veenan chashudin lehaachil et hamedumma: 
Mi sheeno neeman sherinuhu shehifrish maaser rishon mipperot ellu veamar shehifrish mehen maaser sheni neeman. hifrish maaser sheni befanenu veamar shehifrish maaser rishon eno neeman shehashsheni shello. vehanneeman al hashsheni eno neeman al harishon. vehanneeman al harishon neeman al hashsheni. lefichach mi sheeno neeman shehotzi perot mibbeto veamar ellu maaser rishon neeman. veen mafrishin mehen terumot umaasrot. veim amar ellu maaser sheni eno neeman vahare hen demay umafrishin mehen terumat maaser. veyerae li shehu pode et kullam: 
Haomer lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot kach li mimmi shehu measser vehalach velakach vehevi lo eno neeman. veim amar lo kach li meish peloni hare ze neeman lomar mimmennu lakachti shehare mityare shemma yishalennu. halach likkach lo meoto peloni veamar lo metzativ velakachti lecha meacher shehu neeman eno neeman: 
Hannichnas leir veeno makkir adam sham veamar mi kan neeman mi kan measser veamar lo echad ani. eno neeman. amar lo ish peloni hare ze neeman. velokeach meoto peloni af al pi sheeno makkiro veholech veochel al piv. halach velakach mimmennu veshaal lo mi kan mocher yayin yashan amar lo ze sheshshelachacha etzli af al pi shehen kegomlin ze et ze hare ellu neemanin: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheeno makkir adam sham. aval im makkir adam sham lo yikkach ella min hammumche. veim shaha sham sheloshim yom af al pi sheeno makkir adam sham lo yikkach ella min hammumche: 
Velo hittiru devarim ellu ella bitrumot umaasrot. aval leinyan perot sheviit o leinyan tohorot lo yikkach ella min hammumche: 
Hachammarin shennichnesu lair veamar echad mehen perot ellu enam metukkanim uferot chaveri metukkanin eno neeman shemma kenuneya asu benehen: 
Hammocher perot besureya veamar mishshel eretz yisrael hem chayyav hallokeach leasser. meussarin hen neeman shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. mishshelli hen chayyav leasser. meussarin hen neeman shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yadua sheyyesh lo karka besureya vehaya rov mimkaro missadehu chayyav hallokeach mimmennu leasser. shechezkato shemmissadehu heviam: 
Aniyyim sheamru perot ellu shel leket shichcha ufea hare ellu neemanin kol zeman haggoranot shehalleket vehashshichcha vehappea metzuyim. vehu sheyyihye karov min haggoren kede sheyyetze veyavo bo bayyom. veim amru shel maasar ani hem hare ellu neemanin kol hashshana kullah. veenan neemanin ella al davar shedderech bene adam litteno: 
Ketzad. chittim ellu leket shichcha ufea hem hare ellu neemanim. kemach ze shel leket shichcha ufea hu enam neemanin. veen tzarich lomar sheen neemanin al happat lomar mimmattenot aniyyim hu ella mitasserin demay: 
Neemanin al hasseora shel orez veen neemanin alav ben chay ben mevushshal. neemanin al happol veen neemanin al haggerisin ben chayyin ben mevushshalin. neemanin al hashshemen lomar shel maasar ani hu veen neemanin lomar shel zete nikkuf hem. neemanin al hayyarak chay velo mevushshal ella im ken haya davar muat. shekken derech baale battim litten meat yarak mevushshal mikkederato leani. umittoch sheyyachol lomar habbaal habbayit netano li yachol lomar ani bishshaltiv mimmattenotay: 
Vechen ben levi sheamar perot ellu mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato hem hare ze neeman leolam al terumat maaser keshem sheyyisrael neeman al teruma gedola. aval eno neeman alav lefatro mimmaaser sheni: 
En kol haddevarim haellu amurin ella beam haaretz sheeno lo chashud velo neeman. aval mi shehu chashud limkor teruma leshem chullin asur likkach mimmennu kelal davar sheyyesh bo zikkat teruma umaaser afillu kirve dagim mippene shennotnin bahem shemen. veen asur ella kol shellefanav. aval atzaro muttar likkach mimmennu mippene shehu mityare learev teruma beotzaro shemma yivvada haddavar veyafsid hakkol. vechen hechashud lemaaser sheni lemachran leshem chullin en lokchin mimmennu davar sheyyesh alav zikkat maaser. vechol ze kenas middivrehem: 
Chashud sheheid al shel acherim neeman. chazaka en adam chote velo lo. veen tzarich lomar am haaretz. lefichach am haaretz sheamar ze tevel veze teruma ze vadday veze demay afillu beshello neeman. amar ellu perot metukkanin beshel acherim neeman vehu shello yerau keose kenuneya kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammocher perot lachavero veachar sheyyatzu mittachat yado amar lallokeach perot shemmacharti lecha tevalim hen. habbasar besar bechor haya. hayyayin yen nesech. shurat haddin sheeno neeman afillu haya hammocher chaver vehazzariz machamir al atzmo. veim heemino hare ze meshubbach afillu haya hammocher am haaretz:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 13:
Perot shechezkatan min hahefikir. kegon hashshitin veharimin vehaozradin uvenot shuach uvenot shikma vehaggufanin venovlot temara vehen sheadayin lo hittilu seor hannitzpa vehakkusbar vechayyotze bahen. peturin min haddemay. vehallokchan meam haaretz eno tzarich lehaferish mehen terumat maaser velo maaser sheni mippene shechezkatan min hahefker. afillu amar lo am haaretz enam meussarin hare ellu peturin min hammaasrot ad sheyyivvada lo shehen min hashshamur: 
Habbechorot vehasseyyayfot shebbevika peturin min haddemay. veshebbeginna chayyavin mippene shehen nishmarin. veellu hen habbechorot. kol happerot shebbikkeru ad shello hoshivu shomer al habbika lishmor peroteha. vehasseyyayfot hen happerot sheyyishshaaru achar sheyyekappelu hammiktzoot shebbassadot veyannichum belo shomer. vechen hachometz heasuy min hattemadim patur min haddemay: 
Kesheggazru al haddemay lo gazru ella al perot haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel bilvad shehu mikkeziv velifnim ucheziv atzmah kelachutz. vechol happerot hannimtzaot mikkeziv velachutz peturin min haddemay shechezkatan mipperot makom shennimtzeu bo: 
Perot sheyyadua shehen mipperot haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel af al pi shehen nimtzaot besureya veen tzarich lomar baaretz shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim bilvad hare ellu chayyavin bidmay. umafrishin mehen terumat maaser umaaser sheni. lefichach haddevela hashshemena sheen kemotah ella baaretz shehecheziku ole bavel vechen hattemarim haggedolim vehecharuvin hashshavim vehaorez hallavan beyoter vehakkammon haggadol mitasserin demay bechol eretz yisrael uvesureya. vechen kol kayyotze beferot ellu: 
Hachammarim sheheviu perot letzor chayyavin bidmay shechezkatan mehaaretz shehecheziku ole bavel shehi hakkerova lah. vehaorez en choshshin lo ella kol haorez hannimtza chutza laaretz shehi kerova laaretz shehecheziku ole bavel patur min haddemay ella im ken haya nikkar kemo shebbearnu: 
Hallokeach mibbaale otzarot betzor patur min haddemay veen omrin shemma mipperot haaretz atzaro. vechen chamor yechidi shennichnas letzor vehu taun perot patur min haddemay shechezkatan missede hair: 
Hallokeach mibbaale otzar betzidon chayyav bidmay mippene shekkerova hi yoter mitztzor shechezkatah sheotzrin mipperot haaretz shehecheziku ole bavel. aval hallokeach min hachammarim betzidon patur min haddemay mippene shechezkatan shemmeviin michutza laaretz: 
Hallokeach min haakkum baaretz shehecheziku ole bavel im haya taggar akkum shellokeach miyyisrael hare perotav demay. lefichach barishona bizman shehaya rov eretz yisrael beyad yisrael hallokeach mikkol taggar akkum measser demay kelokeach meam haaretz: 
E zehu taggar ze shehevi shetayim veshalosh peamim. aval im hevi paam achat afillu hevi shalosh massoot bevat achat o shehevi hu uveno ufoel adayin lo huchzak taggar: 
Kesheggazru al haddemay lo gazru al perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz: 
Perot haaretz sherabbu al shel chutza laaretz hare ellu chayyavin bidmay. veshel chutza laaretz sherabbu al perot haaretz. vechen devarim shechezkatan tadir michutza laaretz kegon egozim vedurmaskaot hare ellu peturin min haddemay: 
Lo halchu chachamim beferot chutza laaretz lo achar hammare velo achar hattaam vehareach ella achar harov kol sherabbu lo muttar veshello rabbu lo asur. ketzad. rabbu bair aval lo bammedina. o sherabbu bammedina velo rabbu bair. bahar velo rabbu babbika. babbika velo bahar. rabbu lachenvani velo levaal habbayit. levaal habbayit velo lachenvani. ze sherabbu bo muttar. umakom shello rabbu bo chayyav bidmay: 
Rabbu perot chutza laaretz bashshuk venitmaatu chazar hashshuk leyashno vehallokeach mimmennu chayyav bidmay: 
Veellu devarim shello gazru alehen beshaa sheggazru al haddemay. hallokeach perot lizria o lehaachil livhema. kemach leorot o limlugema o lirtiyya. shemen lehadelakat hanner o lasuch bo et hakkelim. yayin lekilor. vechallat am haaretz. vehamedumma. vehallakuach bechesef maaser sheni. usheyare hammenachot. vetosefet habbikkurim. kol ellu peturim min haddemay. vechevan sheamar lo am haaretz metukkanin hem eno tzarich leasser: 
Hallokeach perot laachila venimlach alehem livhema hare ze lo yimkerem leakkum. velo yaachilem livhema afillu levehemat acherim ad sheyyetakkenem demay: 
Shemen arev patur min haddemay sheen chezkato laachila. shemen shellakach hassorek letitto betzemer patur min haddemay mippene shehu nivla batztzemer. aval shemen shellokeach haoreg lasuch ben etzbeotav chayyav bidmay mippene shehu nivla begufo vesicha hi kishtiyya bechol makom: 
Akkum sheshshaal miyyisrael litten lo shemen al makkato asur bevadday umuttar bidmay. natan haakkum shemen al gabbe tavla lehitaggel aleha mishsheamad muttar leyisrael leshev acharav: 
Mi shennafal shemen demay al besaro meshafshefo veeno choshesh. hallokeach yayin lemuryas o laalunetit. o kitniyyot laasot techinin chayyav bidmay. aval hallokeach muryas sheyyesh bo yayin o alunetit o shellakach techinin hare ellu peturin min haddemay shello gazru al taarovet demay. veim haya haddavar shechayyav bidmay shennitarev kegon tavlin useor hoil vetaamo nikkar enan betelim venimtzet kol hattaarovet chayyevet bidmay: 
Kol ellu happeturin min haddemay shello gazru alehem. im hitkinan demay vehifrish mehem terumat maaser umaaser sheni ma sheasa asuy. aval im tikken et haddemay bevadday vehifrish mimmennu teruma gedola umaasrot o shettikken et havvadday bidmay lo asa kelum: 
Kol hair mochrin vadday veechad mocher demay velakach veen yadua mimmi lakach ketzad metakken. mafrish teruma uterumat maaser venotnan lechohen umafrish maaser sheni bilvad vahare hu kemaaser sheni shel demay: 
Vechen im hayu lefanav shete kuppot achat tevel veachat metukkan veavda achat mehem hare ze mafrish min hashsheniyya teruma gedola uterumat maaser venotnan lechol kohen sheyyirtze umafrish maaser sheni bilvad bidmay:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 14:
Halokeach min hassiton vichazar velakach mimmennu paam sheniyya lo yeasser mizze al ze af al pi shehu min echad afillu mikkuppa achat. af al pi shemmakkir et hechavit shehi hi. mippene shehassiton lokeach meanashim harebe umocher. veshemma lakach ze shemmachar techilla meam haaretz shepperotav demay veze shellakach bassof mechaver shepperotav metukkanin. uchevar bearnu sheen measserin min hachayyav al happatur velo min happatur al hachayyav. veim amar hassiton mishshel echad hen neeman: 
Haya mocher keshut o yarak vehen meviin vetzovrin lefanav hallokeach mimmennu measser mikkol keshut ucheshut umikkol agudda vaagudda umikkol temara utemara: 
Hallokeach mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya. measser mizze al ze. afillu mishshete kuppot afillu mishshete ayarot. shechezkato sheeno mocher ella mishshello: 
Baal habbayit shehaya mocher yarak bashshuk bizman shemmeviin lo migginnotav measser meechad al hakkol. uvizman shemmeviin lo migginnot acherot im lakach mimmennu vechazar velakach mimmennu paam sheniyya lo yeasser mizze al ze: 
Hallokeach pat min hannachtom lo yeasser min hachamma al hatztzonenet sheani omer chittim shel emesh hayu mishshel echad veshel hayyom mishshel acher: 
Hallokeach min happalter af al pi shehen defusin harebe measser meechad al hakkol. shehannachtom shemmocher lammanpol ose issato defusin harebe. aval hallokeach min hammanpol measser mikkol defus udefus. shehammanpol lokeach mishshene nachtomin: 
Tisha manpolin shellakchu measara nachtomin hoil veechad mehen lakach mishshenayim kol hallokeach meechad min hattisha measser mikkol defus udefus: 
Hallokeach min heani vechen heani shennatnu lo perusot pat o pilche devela measser mikkol achat veachat. uvitmarim uvigrogarot bolel hakkol umeasser. ematay bizman shehammattana merubba. aval bemuetet measser mikkol mattana umattana: 
Shachak et happat vaasaah perurin veet haggerogarot vaasaan devela measser meechad al hakkol: 
Poalim o orchim shehayu mesubbin veochlin vehotiru perusot measser mikkol achat veachat: seliku lehu hilchot maoser besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 1:
Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim mittalmud tora. aval katan aviv chayyav lelammedo tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 11 19)</small> "velimmadtem otam et benechem ledabber bam". veen haishsha chayyevet lelammed et benah. shekkol hachayyav lilmod chayyav lelammed: 
Keshem shechayyav adam lelammed et beno kach hu chayyav lelammed et ben beno shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha". velo beno uven beno bilvad ella mitzva al kol chacham vechacham miyyisrael lelammed et kol hattalmidim af al pi sheenan banav. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "veshinnantam levanecha" mippi hashshemua lamdu banecha ellu talmidecha shehattalmidim keruyin banim shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 2 3)</small> "vayyetzu vene hanneviim". im ken lamma nitztavva al beno veal ben beno. lehakedim beno leven beno uven beno leven chavero:
Vechayyav liskor melammed livno lelammedo. veeno chayyav lelammed ben chavero ella bechinnam. mi shello limmedo aviv chayyav lelammed et atzmo kesheyyakkir shenneemar <small>(Devarim 5 1)</small> "ulemadtem otam ushemartem laasotam". vechen atta motze bechol makom shehattalmud kodem lammaase mippene shehattalmud mevi lide maase veen hammaase mevi lide talmud:
Haya hu rotze lilmod tora veyesh lo ben lilmod tora hu kodem livno. veim haya beno navon umaskil lehavin ma sheyyilmod yoter mimmennu beno kodem. veaf al pi shebbeno kodem lo yibbatel hu. shekkeshem shemmitzva alav lelammed et beno kach hu metzuvve lelammed atzmo:
Leolam yilmod adam tora veachar kach yissa ishsha sheim nasa ishsha techilla en dato penuya lilmod. veim haya yitzro mitgabber alav ad shennimtza sheen libbo panuy yissa veachar kach yilmod tora:
Meematay aviv chayyav lelammedo tora. mishsheyyatchil ledabber melammedo <small>(Devarim 33 4)</small> "tora tzivva lanu mshe" u<small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael", veachar kach melammedo meat meat pesukim pesukim ad sheyyihye ben shesh o ben sheva hakkol lefi buryo. umolicho etzel melammed hattinokot:
Haya minhag hammedina likkach melammed hattinokot sachar noten lo secharo. vechayyav lelammedo besachar ad sheyyikra tora shebbichtav kullah. makom shennahagu lelammed tora shebbichtav besachar muttar lelammed besachar. aval tora shebbeal pe asur lelammedah besachar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 5)</small> "ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai" vegomer ma ani bechinnam lamadti af attem lemadtem bechinnam mimmenni vechen keshettelammedu ledorot lammedu bechinnam kemo shellemadtem mimmenni. lo matza mi sheyyelammedo bechinnam yelammedo besachar shenneemar emet kene. yachol yelammed laacherim besachar. talmud lomar <small>(Mishlei 23 23)</small> "veal timkor". ha lamadta sheasur lo lelammed besachar af al pi shellimmedo rabbo besachar:
Kol ish miyyisrael chayyav betalmud tora ben ani ben ashir ben shalem begufo ben baal yissurin ben bachur ben shehaya zaken gadol shettashash kocho afillu haya ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka umechazzer al happetachim vaafillu baal ishsha uvanim chayyav likboa lo zeman letalmud tora bayyom uvallayla shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 1 8)</small> "vehagita bo yomam valayla":
Gedole chachme yisrael hayu mehen chotve etzim umehen shoave mayim umehen sumim veaf al pi chen hayu oskin betalmud tora bayyom uvallayla vehem mikkelal matike hashshemua ish mippi ish mippi moshe rabbenu:
Ad ematay chayyav lilmod tora ad yom moto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "ufen yasuru millevavcha kol yeme chayyecha". vechol zeman shello yaasok belimmud hu shocheach:
Vechayyav leshallesh et zeman lemidato. shelish battora shebbichtav. ushelish battora shebbeal pe. ushelish yavin veyaskil acharit davar mereshito veyotzi davar middavar vidamme davar ledavar veyavin bammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen ad sheyyeda heach hu ikkar hammiddot veheach yotzi haasur vehammuttar vechayyotze bahen middevarim shellamad mippi hashshemua. veinyan ze hu hannikra gemara:
Ketzad. haya baal ummanut vehaya osek bimlachto shalosh shaot bayyom uvattora tesha. otan hattesha kore beshalosh mehen battora shebbichtav uveshalosh battora shebbeal pe uveshalosh acherot mitbonen bedato lehavin davar middavar. vedivre kabbala bichlal tora shebbichtav hen uferushan bichlal tora shebbeal pe. vehainyanim hannikraim pardes bichlal haggemara hen. bamme devarim amurim bitchillat talmudo shel adam aval kesheyyagdil bechachma velo yehe tzarich lo lilmod tora shebbichtav velo laasok tamid battora shebbeal pe yikra beittim mezummanim tora shebbichtav vedivre hashshemua kede shello yishkach davar middivre dine tora veyifne kol yamav laggemara bilvad lefi rochav sheyyesh belibbo veyishshuv dato:
Ishsha shellamda tora yesh lah sachar aval eno kischar haish. mippene shello nitztavvet. vechol haose davar sheeno metzuvve alav laasoto en secharo kischar hametzuvve sheasa ella pachot mimmennu. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah sachar tziuu chachamim shello yelammed adam et bitto tora. mippene sherov hannashim en datam mechuvvenet lehitlammed ella hen motziot divre tora ledivre havay lefi aniyyut datan. amru chachamim kol hamelammed et bitto tora keillu limmedah tiflut. bamme devarim amurim betora shebbeal pe aval tora shebbichtav lo yelammed otah lechattechilla veim limmedah eno kimlammedah tiflut:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 2: Moshivin melammede tinokot bechol medina umedina uvechol pelech ufelech uvechol ir vair. vechol ir sheen bah tinokot shel bet rabban machrimin et anshe hair ad shemmoshivin melammede tinokot. veim lo hoshivu machrimin et hair. sheen haolam mitkayyem ella behevel pihem shel tinokot shel bet rabban:

Machnisin et hattinokot lehitlammed keven shesh keven sheva lefi koach habben uvinyan gufo. ufachot mibben shesh en machnisim oto. umakke otan hamelammed lehattil alehem ema. veeno makke otam makkat oyev makkat achzari. lefichach lo yakke otam beshotim velo bemaklot ella birtzua ketanna. veyoshev umelammedan kol hayyom kullo umiktzat min hallayla kede lechannechan lilmod bayyom uvallayla. velo yibbatlu hattinokot kelal chutz mearve shabbatot veyamim tovim besof hayyamim uveyamim tovim. aval beshabbat en korin battechilla aval shonin barishon. veen mevattelin hattinokot vaafillu levinyan bet hammikdash:

Melammed hattinokot shehu meniach hattinokot veyotze o shehu ose melacha acheret immahen o shehu mitrashshel belimmudan hare ze bichlal <small>(yirmeya moach 10)</small> "arur ose melechet Adonai remiyya". lefichach en rauy lehoshiv melammed ella baal yira mahir likrot uledakdek:
Umi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed tinokot mippene immotehem habbaot etzel benehem. vechol ishsha lo telammed tinokot mippene avotehem shehem baim etzel habbanim:

Esrim vachamishsha tinokot lemedim etzel melammed echad. hayu yoter al esrim vachamishsha ad arbaim moshivin immo acher lesayyeo belimmudam. hayu yoter al arbaim maamidin lahem shene melammede tinokot:

Molichin et hakkatan mimmelammed limlammed acher shehu mahir mimmennu ben bemikra ben bedikduk. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu shenehem beir achat velo haya hannahar mafsik benehem. aval meir leir o mitztzad hannahar letziddo afillu beotah hair en molichin et hakkatan ella im ken haya binyan bari al gabbe hannahar binyan sheeno rauy lippol bimhera:

Echad mibbene mavoy shebbikkesh leheasot melammed, afillu echad mibbene hechatzer, en yecholin shechenav limchot beyado. vechen melammed tinokot shebba chavero ufatach bayit lelammed tinokot betziddo kede sheyyavou tinokot acherim lo o kede sheyyavou mittinokot shel ze etzel ze, eno yachol limchot beyado, shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 42 21)</small> "Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir":
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 3: Bishlosha ketarim nichteru yisrael. keter tora vecheter kehunna vecheter malchut. keter kehunna zacha bo aharon shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 25 13)</small> "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam". keter malchut zacha bo david shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 89 37)</small> "zaro leolam yihye vechiso chashshemesh negdi". keter tora hare munnach veomed umuchan lechol yisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33 4)</small> "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov". kol mi sheyyirtze yavo veyittol. shemma tomar sheotam hakketarim gedolim mikketer tora. hare hu omer <small>(Mishlei 8 15)</small> "bi melachim yimlochu veroznim yechokku tzedek" <small>(Mishlei 8 16)</small> "bi sarim yasoru". ha lamadta shekketer tora gadol mishshenehem:
Amru chachamim mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 15)</small> "yekara hi mippeninim". mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim:
En lecha mitzva bechol hammitzvot kullan shehi shekula keneged talmud tora ella talmud tora keneged kol hammitzvot kullan shehattalmud mevi lide maase. lefichach hattalmud kodem lemaase bechol makom:
Haya lefanav asiyyat mitzva vetalmud tora. im efshar lammitzva leheasot al yede acherim lo yafsik talmudo. veim lav yaase hammitzva veyachazor letalmudo:

Techillat dino shel adam eno niddon ella al hattalmud veachar kach al shear maasav. lefichach amru chachamim leolam yaasok adam battora ben lishmah ben shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah:

Mi shennesao libbo lekayyem mitzva zo karauy velihyot muchtar becheter tora. lo yassiach dato lidvarim acherim. velo yasim al libbo sheyyikne tora im haosher vehakkavod keachat. <small>(mishna avot 6 4)</small> "kach hi darkah shel tora. pat bammelach tochal umayim bammesura tishte veal haaretz tishan vechayye tzaar tichye uvattora atta amel". velo alecha haddavar ligmor velo atta ben chorin libbatel mimmenna. veim hirbeta tora hirbeta sachar. vehassachar lefi hatztzaar:

Shemma tomar ad sheakabbetz mamon echezor veekra. ad sheekne ma sheani tzarich veeppane measakay veechezor veekra. im taale machashava zo al libbecha en atta zoche lechitrah shel tora leolam. ella ase toratcha keva umelachtecha aray <small>(mishna avot 2 4)</small> velo tomar "lichsheeppane eshne shemma lo tippane":

Katuv battora <small>(gemara eruvin noah 1)</small> "lo vashshamayim hi velo meever layyam hi". lo vashshamayim hi lo begasse haruach hi metzuya velo bimhalleche meever layyam hi. lefichach amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 2 5)</small> "lo kol hammarbe bischora machkim". vetziuu chachamim heve memaet beesek vaasok battora:

Divre tora nimshelu kammayim shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noah 1)</small> "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim". lomar lecha ma mayim enam mitkannesin bimkom midron ella nizchalin mealav umitkabbetzim bimkom ashboren kach divre tora enam nimtzaim begasse haruach velo belev kol geva lev ella bedakka ushefal ruach shemmitabbek baafar ragle hachachamim umesir hattaavot vetaanuge hazzeman millibbo veose melacha bechol yom meat kede chayyav im lo haya lo ma yochal ushear yomo velelo osek battora:

Kol hammesim al libbo sheyyaasok battora velo yaase melacha veyitparnes min hatztzedaka hare ze chillel et hashshem uvizza et hattora vechibba meor haddat vegaram raa leatzmo venatal chayyav min haolam habba. lefi sheasur lehanot middivre tora baolam hazze. amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 5)</small> "kol hannehene middivre tora natal chayyav min haolam". veod tziuu veamru <small>(mishna avot 4 5)</small> "al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahen velo kardom lachpor bahen". veod tziuu veamru <small>(mishna avot 1 10)</small> "ehov et hammelacha usena et harabbanut", <small>(mishna avot 2 2)</small> "vechol tora sheen immah melacha sofah betela vegoreret avon". vesof adam ze sheyyehe melastem et habberiyyot:

Maala gedola hi lemi shehu mitparnes mimmaase yadav. umiddat chasidim harishonim hi. uvaze zoche lechol kavod vetova shebbaolam hazze velaolam habba shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 128 2)</small> "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach" <small>(mishna avot 6 4)</small> "ashrecha baolam hazze vetov lach laolam habba" shekkullo tov:

En divre tora mitkayyemin bemi shemmarpe atzmo alehen. velo beellu shellomdin mittoch iddun umittoch achila ushetiyya. ella bemi shemmemit atzmo alehen umetzaer gufo tamid velo yitten shena leenav uleafappav tenuma. amru chachamim derech remez <small>(Bamidbar 19 14)</small> "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel" en hattora mitkayyemet ella bemi shemmemit atzmo beohole hachachamim. vechen amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 24 10)</small> "hitrappita beyom tzara tzar kochecha". veod amar <small>(Kohelet 2 9)</small> "af chachmati amda li" chachma shellamadti beaf hi amda li. amru chachamim berit keruta shekkol hayyagea betorato bevet hammidrash lo bimhera hu meshakkeach. vechol hayyagea betalmudo betzina machkim shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 11 2)</small> "veet tzenuim chachma". vechol hammashmia kolo bishat talmudo talmudo mitkayyem beyado. aval hakkore belachash bimhera hu shocheach:

Af al pi shemmitzva lilmod bayyom uvallayla en adam lamed rov chachmato ella ballayla. lefichach mi sheratza lizkot becheter hattora yizzaher bechol lelotav velo yeabbed afillu echad mehen beshena vaachila ushetiyya vesicha vechayyotze bahen ella betalmud tora vedivre chachma. amru chachamim en rinna shel tora ella ballayla shenneemar <small>(Eicha 2 19)</small> "kumi ronni vallayla". vechol haosek battora ballayla chut shel chesed nimshach alav bayyom shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 42 9)</small> "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi tefilla leel chayyay". vechol bayit sheen nishmaim bo divre tora ballayla esh ochalto shenneemar <small>(Iyov 20 26)</small> "kol choshech tamun litzpunav teachlehu esh lo nuppach". <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "ki devar Adonai baza" ze shello hishgiach al divre tora kol ikkar. vechen kol sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek o shekkara veshana uferash lehavele olam veheniach talmudo uzenacho hare ze bichlal boze devar Adonai. amru chachamim kol hamevattel et hattora meosher sofo levattelah meoni vechol hamekayyem et hattora meoni sofo lekayyemah meosher. veinyan ze meforash hu battora, hare hu omer <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kl" <small>(Devarim 28 48)</small> "veavadta et oyvecha". veomer <small>(Devarim 8 2)</small> "lemaan annotcha" <small>(Devarim 8 16)</small> "lehetivcha beacharitecha":
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 4: En melammedin tora ella letalmid hagun nae bemaasav. o letam. aval im haya holech bederech lo tova machzirin oto lammutav umanhigin oto bederech yeshara uvodkin oto veachar kach machnisin oto levet hammidrash umelammedin oto. amru chachamim kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun keillu zarak even lemarkulis shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 26 8)</small> "kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod". veen kavod ella tora shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 la)</small> "kavod chachamim yinchalu". vechen harav sheeno holech bederech tova af al pi shechacham gadol hu vechol haam tzerichin lo en mitlammedin mimmennu ad shuvo lammutav. shenneemar <small>(Malachi 2 7)</small> "ki sifte chohen yishmeru daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach Adonai tzevaot hu". amru chachamim im harav dome lemalach Adonai tzevaot tora yevakkeshu mippihu im lav al yevakkeshu tora mippihu:

Ketzad melammedim. harav yoshev barosh vehattalmidim mukkafim lefanav kaatara kede sheyyehu kullam roim harav veshomim devarav. velo yeshev harav al hakkisse vetalmidav al hakkarka ella o hakkol al haaretz o hakkol al hakkisot. uvarishona haya harav yoshev vehattalmidim omdim umikkodem churban bayit sheni nahagu hakkol lelammed lattalmidim vehem yoshvim:

Im haya melammed mippiv lattalmidim melammed. veim haya melammed al pi metargem [hametargem] omed beno uven hattalmidim veharav omer lamtargem vehametargem mashmia lechol hattalmidim. ucheshehem shoalin lamtargem hu shoel larav veharav meshiv lamtargem vehametargem meshiv lashshoel. velo yagbiah harav kolo yoter mikkol hametargem. velo yagbiah hametargem kolo beet sheshshoel et harav yoter mikkol harav. en hametargem rashshay lo lifchot velo lehosif velo leshannot ella im ken haya hameturgeman aviv shel chacham o rabbo. omer harav lamturgeman kach amar li rabbi o kach amar li abba mari. uchesheomer hameturgeman haddevarim laam omer beshem hechacham umazkir shemo shel avi harav o shel rabbo veomer kach amar rabbana peloni af al pi shello hizkir harav shemo shel chacham. sheasur likrot lerabbo o leaviv bishmo:

Harav shellimmed velo hevinu hattalmidim lo yichos alehem veyirgaz ella chozer veshone haddavar afillu kamma peamim ad sheyyavinu omek hahalacha. vechen lo yomar hattalmid hevanti vehu lo hevin ella chozer veshoel afillu kamma peamim. veim kaas alav rabbo veragaz yomar lo rabbi tora hi velilmod ani tzarich vedati ketzara:

Lo yihye hattalmid bosh mechaverav shellamdu mippaam rishona o sheniyya vehu lo lamad ella achar kamma peamim. sheim nitbayyesh middavar ze nimtza nichnas veyotze levet hammidrash vehu eno lamed kelum. lefichach amru chachamim harishonim en habbayshan lamed velo hakkappedan melammed. bamme devarim amurim bizman shello hevinu hattalmidim haddavar mippene amko o mippene datan shehi ketzara. aval im nikkar larav shehem mitrashshelin bedivre tora umitrappin alehen ulefichach lo hevinu chayyav lirgoz alehen ulehachliman bidvarim kede lechaddedam. ucheinyan ze amru chachamim zerok mara battalmidim. lefichach en rauy larav linhog kallut rosh lifne hattalmidim velo lischok bifnehem velo leechol velishtot immahem kede shettehe emato alehen veyilmedu mimmennu bimhera:

En shoalin et harav kesheyyikkanes lammidrash ad shettityashshev dato alav. veen hattalmid shoel kesheyyikkanes ad sheyyityashshev veyanuach. veen shoalin shenayim keechad. veen shoalin et harav meinyan acher ella meoto hainyan shehen asukin bo kede shello yitbayyesh. veyesh larav lehateot et hattalmidim bishelotav uvammaasim sheose bifnehem kede lechaddedan. uchede sheyyeda im zochrim hem ma shellimmedam o enam zochrim. veen tzarich lomar sheyyesh lo reshut lishl otam beinyan acher sheen oskin bo kede lezarzam:
