En shoalin meummad veen meshivin meummad velo miggavoah velo merachok velo meachore hazzekenim. veen shoalin harav ella beinyan shehen korin bo. veen shoalin ella miyyira. velo yishal bainyan yoter mishshalosh halachot:

Shenayim sheshshaalu. shaal echad kainyan veshaal echad shello kainyan nizkakin lainyan. maase vesheeno maase nizkakin lammaase. halacha umidrash nizkakin lahalacha. midrash veaggada nizkakin lammidrash. aggada vekal vachomer nizkakin lakkal vachomer. kal vachomer ugezera shava nizkakin lakkal vachomer. hayu hashshoalin shenayim echad chacham veechad talmid nizkakin lechacham. talmid veam haaretz nizkakin lattalmid. shenehem chachamim shenehem talmidim shenehem amme haaretz shaalu shenehem bishte halachot o bishte teshuvot o bishte sheelot shene maasim. harshut beyad hametargem meatta:

En yeshenim bevet hammidrash vechol hammitnamnem bevet hammidrash chachmato naaset keraim keraim. vechen amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 23 21)</small> "ukeraim talbish numa". veen mesichin bevet hammidrash ella bedivre tora bilvad. afillu mi shennitattesh en omrim lo refua bevet hammidrash veen tzarich lomar shear haddevarim. ukedushshat bet hammidrash chamura mikkedushshat batte kenesiyyot:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5:
Keshem sheadam metzuvve bichvod aviv veyirato kach hu chayyav bichvod rabbo veyirato yeter meaviv. sheaviv mevio lechayye haolam hazze verabbo shellimmedo chachma mevio lechayye haolam habba. raa avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo shel rabbo kodemet leshel aviv. aviv verabbo nosim bemassa meniach et shel rabbo veachar kach shel aviv. aviv verabbo shevuyim bashshivya pode et rabbo veachar kach pode et aviv. veim haya aviv talmid chacham pode et aviv techilla. vechen im haya aviv talmid chacham af al pi sheeno shakul keneged rabbo meshiv avedato veachar kach meshiv avedat rabbo. veen lecha kavod gadol mikkevod harav velo mora mimmora harav. amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 12)</small> "mora rabbach kemora shamayim". lefichach amru kol hacholek al rabbo kecholek al hashshechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 26 9)</small> "behatztzotam al Adonai". vechol haose meriva im rabbo keose meriva im hashshechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 20 13)</small> "asher ravu vene yisrael et Adonai vayyikkadesh bam". vechol hammitraem al rabbo kemitraem al Adonai shenneemar <small>(Shemot 16 8)</small> "lo alenu telunotechem ki al Adonai". vechol hameharher achar rabbo keillu mehareher achar shechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 21 5)</small> "vaydabber haam belohim uvemshe":
Ezehu cholek al rabbo. ze shekkovea lo midrash veyoshev vedoresh umelammed shello birshut rabbo verabbo kayyam veaf al pi sherabbo bimdina acheret. veasur laadam lehorot bifne rabbo leolam. vechol hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyav mita:
Haya beno uven rabbo shenem asar mil veshaal lo adam devar halacha muttar lehashiv. ulehafrish min haissur afillu bifne rabbo muttar lehorot. ketzad. kegon sheraa adam ose davar haasur mippene shello yada beissuro o mippene risho yesh lo lehaferisho velomar lo davar ze asur vaafillu bifne rabbo veaf al pi shello natan lo rabbo reshut. shekkol makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav. bamme devarim amurim. bedavar shennikra mikre. aval likboa atzmo lehoraa veleshev ulehorot lechol shoel afillu hu besof haolam verabbo besof haolam asur lo lehorot ad sheyyamut rabbo ella im ken natal reshut merabbo. velo kol mi shemmet rabbo muttar lo leshev ulehorot battora. ella im ken haya talmid shehiggia lehoraa:
Vechol talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore hare ze rasha shote vegas haruach. vealav neemar <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" vegomer. vechen chacham shehiggia lehoraa veeno more hare ze monea tora venoten michsholot lifne haivverim vealav neemar <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "vaatzumim kol harugeha". ellu hattalmidim hakketannim shello hirbu tora karauy vehem mevakkeshim lehitgaddel bifne amme haaretz uven anshe iram vekoftzin veyoshvin barosh ledin ulehorot beyisrael hem hammarbim hammachaloket vehem hammacharivim et haolam vehamechabbin nerah shel tora vehamechabbelim kerem Adonai tzevaot. alehem amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Shir HaShirim 2 15)</small> "echezu lanu shualim shualim ketannim mechabbelim keramim":
Veasur lo letalmid likrot lerabbo bishmo vaafillu shello befanav. vehu sheyyihye hashshem peli shekkol hashshomea yeda shehu peloni. velo yazkir shemo befanav vaafillu likrot laacherim sheshshemam keshem rabbo kederech sheose beshem aviv. ella yeshanne et shemam afillu leachar motam. velo yitten shalom lerabbo o yachazir lo shalom kederech shennotnim lereim umachazirim ze laze. ella shoche lefanav veomer lo beyira vechavod shalom alecha rabbi. veim natan lo rabbo shalom yachazir lo shalom alecha rabbi umori:
Vechen lo yachalotz tefillav lifne rabbo. velo yasev ella yoshev keyoshev lifne hammelech. velo yitpallel lo lifne rabbo velo leachar rabbo velo betzad rabbo. veen tzarich lomar sheasur lo lehallech betziddo. ella yitrachek leachar rabbo velo yehe mechavven keneged achorav veachar kach yitpallel. velo yikkanes im rabbo bammerchatz. velo yeshev bimkom rabbo. velo yachria devarav befanav. velo yistor et devarav. velo yeshev lefanav ad sheyyomar lo shev. velo yaamod millefanav ad sheyyomar lo amod o ad sheyyittol reshut laamod. uchesheyyippater merabbo lo yachazor lo laachorav ella nirta laachorav ufanav keneged panav:
Vechayyav laamod mippene rabbo mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav ad sheyyitkasse mimmennu velo yire komato veachar kach yeshev. vechayyav adam lehakebil pene rabbo baregel:
En cholkin kavod letalmid bifne rabbo ella im ken derech rabbo lachalok lo kavod. vechol hammelachot shehaeved ose lerabbo talmid ose lerabbo. veim haya bemakom sheen makkirin oto velo hayu lo tefillin vechash shemma yomru eved hu eno noel lo minalo veeno choltzo. vechol hammonea talmido milleshammesho monea mimmennu chesed uforek mimmennu yirat shamayim. vechol talmid shemmezalzel davar mikkol kevod rabbo gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael:
Raa rabbo over al divre tora omer lo limmadtanu rabbenu kach vechach. vechol zeman shemmazkir shemua befanav omer lo kach limmadtanu rabbenu. veal yomar davar shello shama merabbo ad sheyyazkir shem omro. uchesheyyamut rabbo korea kol begadav ad shehu megalle et libbo veeno meache leolam. bamme devarim amurim berabbo muvhak shellamad mimmennu rov chachmato. aval im lo lamad mimmennu rov chachmato hare ze talmid chaver veeno chayyav bichvodo bechol ellu haddevarim. aval omed millefanav vekorea alav keshem shehu korea al kol hammetim shehu mitabbel alehem. afillu lo lamad mimmennu ella davar echad ben katan ben gadol omed millefanav vekorea alav:
Vechol talmid chacham sheddeotav mechuvvanot eno medabber bifne mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma af al pi shello lamad mimmennu kelum:
Harav hammuvhak sheratza limchol al kevodo bechol haddevarim haellu o beechad mehen lechol talmidav o leechad mehen harshut beyado. veaf al pi shemmachal chayyav hattalmid lehaddero vaafillu beshaa shemmachal:
Keshem shehattalmidim chayyavin bichvod harav kach harav tzarich lechabbed et talmidav ulekarvan. kach amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 12)</small> "yehi kevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha". vetzarich adam lehizzaher betalmidav uleohovam shehem habbanim hamehannim laolam hazze velaolam habba:
Hattalmidim mosifin chachmat harav umarchivin libbo. amru chachamim harebe chachma lamadti merabbotay veyoter mechaveray umittalmiday yoter mikkullam. ucheshem sheetz katan madlik et haggadol kach talmid katan mechadded harav ad sheyyotzi mimmennu bishelotav chachma mefoara:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6: Kol talmid chacham mitzva lehaddero veaf al pi sheeno rabbo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken". zaken ze shekkana chachma. umeematay chayyavin laamod mippanav. mishsheyyikrav mimmennu bearba ammot ad sheyyaavor mikkeneged panav:

En omdin mippanav lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "takum vehadarta" kima sheyyesh bah hiddur. veen baale ummanuyyot chayyavin laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskin bimlachtan shenneemar takum vehadarta ma hiddur sheen bah chesron kis af kima sheen bah chesron kis. uminnayin shello yaatzim enav min hechacham kede shello yirehu ad shello yaamod mippanav. shenneemar veyareta meelohecha. ha kol davar shehu masur lallev neemar bo veyareta meelohecha:

En rauy lechacham sheyyatriach et haam vichavven atzmo lahen kede sheyyaamdu mippanav ella yelech bederech ketzara umitkavven shello yiru oto kede shello yatrichen laamod. vehachachamim hayu makkifin veholchin bederech hachitzona sheen makkirehen metzuyin sham kede shello yatrichum:
Rochev hare hu kimhallech ucheshem sheomdim mippene hamehallech kach omdin mippene harochev:
Shelosha shehayu holchin badderech. harav baemtza gadol mimino vekatan missemolo:

Haroe chacham eno omed mippanav ad sheyyaggia lo learba ammot. vechevan sheavar yoshev. raa av bet din omed millefanav mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyaavor meacharav arba ammot. raa et hannasi omed millefanav melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyeshev bimkomo o ad sheyyitkasse meenav. vehannasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul. keshehannasi nichnas kol haam omdim veenan yoshvin ad sheyyomar lahem shevu. kesheav bet din nichnas osin lo shete shurot veomdin mikkan umikkan ad shennichnas veyoshev bimkomo ushear haam yoshvin bimkoman:

Chacham shennichnas kol sheyyaggia lo bearba ammot omed millefanav echad omed veechad yoshev ad shennichnas veyoshev bimkomo. bene chachamim vetalmide chachamim bizman sheharabbim tzerichin lahem mekappetzin al rashe haam venichnasim limkomam. veen shevach letalmide chachamim sheyyikkansu laacharona. yatza letzorech chozer limkomo. bene chachamim bizman sheyyesh bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe avihen. en bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe haam:
Talmid shehu yoshev lifne rabbo tamid eno rashshay laamod mippanav ella shacharit vearvit bilvad shello yehe kevodo merubbe mikkevod shamayim:

Mi shehu zaken muflag bezikna af al pi sheeno chacham omdin lefanav. vaafillu hechacham shehu yeled omed bifne hazzaken hammuflag bezikna. veeno chayyav laamod melo komato ella kede lehaddero. vaafillu zaken kuti mehadderin oto bidvarim venotnin lo yad lesamcho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "mippene seva takum" kol seva bemashma:

Talmide chachamim enam yotzin beatzman laasot im kol hakkahal bevinyan vachafira shel medina vechayyotze bahen kede shello yitbazzu bifne amme haaretz. veen govin mehen levinyan hachoma vetikkun hashshearim usechar hashshomrim vechayyotze bahen velo litshurat hammelech. veen mechayyevim otan litten hammas ben mas shehu katzuv al bene hair ben mas shehu katzuv al kol ish vaish shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 8 10)</small> "gam ki yitnu vaggoyim atta akabbetzem vayyachellu meat mimmassa melech vesarim". vechen im hayta sechora letalmid chacham menichim oto limkor techilla veen menichim echad mibbene hashshuk limkor ad sheyyimkor hu. vechen im haya lo din vehaya omed bichlal baale dinim harebe makdimin oto umoshivin oto:

Avon gadol hu levazzot et hachachamim o lisnotan. lo charva yerushalayim ad shebbizzu bah talmide chachamim shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 36 16)</small> "vayyihyu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav". kelomar bozim melammede devarav. vechen ze sheamra tora <small>(Vayikra 26 15)</small> "im bechukkotay timasu", melammede chukkotay timasu. vechol hamevazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba vahare hu bichlal <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "ki devar Adonai baza":

Af al pi shehamevazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba, im bau edim shebbizzahu afillu bidvarim chayyav nidduy, umenaddin oto bet din barabbim vekonsin oto litra zahav bechol makom venotnin otah lechacham. vehamevazze et hechacham bidvarim afillu leachar mita menaddin oto bet din vehem mattirim oto kesheyyachazor bitshuva. aval im haya hechacham chay en mattirin oto ad sheyyeratztze ze shennidduhu bishvilo. vechen hechacham atzmo menadde lichvodo leam haaretz shehifkir bo veen tzarich lo edim velo hateraa. veen mattirin lo ad sheyyeratztze et hechacham. veim met hechacham bain shelosha umattirin lo. veim ratza hechacham limchol lo velo niddahu harshut beyado:

Harav shennidda lichvodo kol talmidav chayyavin linhog nidduy bamnudde. aval talmid shennidda lichvod atzmo en harav chayyav linhog bo nidduy. aval kol haam chayyavin linhog bo nidduy. vechen menudde lenasi menudde lechol yisrael. menudde lechol yisrael eno menudde lannasi. menudde leiro menudde leir acheret. menudde leir acheret eno menudde leiro:

Bamme devarim amurim bemi shennidduhu al shebbizza talmide chachamim. aval mi shennidduhu al shear devarim shechayyavim alehem nidduy afillu niddahu katan shebbeyisrael chayyav hannasi vechol yisrael linhog bo nidduy ad sheyyachazor bitshuva middavar shennidduhu bishvilo veyattiru lo. al esrim vearbaa devarim menaddin et haadam ben ish ben ishsha. veellu hen: 1) hamevazze et hechacham vaafillu leachar moto. 2) hamevazze sheliach bet din. 3) hakkore lachavero eved. 4) mi sheshshalchu lo bet din vekavu lo zeman velo ba. 5) hamezalzel bedavar echad middivre sofrim veen tzarich lomar bedivre tora. 6) mi shello kibbel alav et haddin menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. 7) mi sheyyesh birshuto davar hammazzik kegon kelev ra o sullam raua menaddin oto ad sheyyasir hezzeko. 8) hammocher karka shello leoved kochavim menaddin oto ad sheyyekabbel alav kol ones sheyyavo min haoved kochavim leyisrael chavero baal hammetzar. 9) hammeid al yisrael bearkaot shel ovde kochavim vehotzi mimmennu beeduto mamon shello kedin yisrael, menaddin oto ad sheyyeshallem. 10) tabbach kohen sheeno mafrish hammattanot venotnan lechohen acher menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. 11) hamechallel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot af al pi shehu minhag. 12) haose melacha beerev happesach achar chatzot. 13) hammazkir shem shamayim levattala o lishvua bedivre havay. yad) hammevi et harabbim lide chillul hashshem. 15) hammevi et harabbim lide achilat kadashim bachutz. 16) hamechashshev shanim vekovea chodashim bechutza laaretz. 17) hammachishil et haivver. 18) hameakkev harabbim millaasot mitzva. 19) tabbach sheyyatza terefa mittachat yado. 20) tabbach shello badak sakkino lifne chacham. ka) hammakshe atzmo ledaat. 22) mi sheggeresh et ishto veasa beno uvenah shuttafut o massa umattan hammeviin lahen lehizzakek ze laze kesheyyavou levet din menaddin otam. 23) chacham sheshshemuato raa. kad) hamenadde mi sheeno chayyav nidduy:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 7: Chacham zaken bechachma vechen nasi o av bet din shessarach en menaddin oto befarhesya leolam. ella im ken asa keyaravam ben nevat vachaverav. aval keshechata shear chattaot malkin oto betzina. shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 4 5)</small> "vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam navi immecha layla" af al pi shekkashal kassehu kelayla. veomrim lo hikkaved veshev bevetcha. vechen kol talmid chacham shennitchayyev nidduy asur levet din likpotz ulenaddoto bimhera ella borchin middavar ze venishmatin mimmennu. vachaside hachachamim hayu mishtabbechim shello nimnu meolam lenaddot talmid chacham af al pi shennimnin lehalekoto im nitchayyev malkot. vaafillu makkat mardut nimnin alav lehakkoto:
Vechetzad hu hannidduy, omer peloni yehe beshammata. veim nidduhu befanav omer lo peloni ze beshammata. vehacherem, omer lo peloni muchram. vearur bo ala bo shevua bo nidduy:
Vechetzad mattirin hannidduy o hacherem. omer lo sharuy lecha umachul lecha. veim hittiruhu shello befanav omer lo peloni sharuy lo umachul lo:

Mahu hamminhag sheyyinhog hamenudde beatzmo veshennohagin immo. menudde asur lesapper ulechabbes keavel kol yeme nidduyo. veen mezammenin alav. velo kollin oto baasara lechol davar shetztzarich asara. velo yoshvin immo bearba ammot. aval shone hu laacherim veshonin lo veniskar vesocher. veim met benidduy bet din sholchin umannichin even al arono kelomar shehen rogmin oto lefi shehu muvdal min hatztzibbur. veen tzarich lomar sheen maspidin oto veen melavvin et mittato:

Yoter alav hammuchram sheeno shone laacherim veen shonin lo aval shone hu leatzmo shello yishkach talmudo. veeno niskar veen niskarin lo. veen nosin venotnin immo. veen mitassekin immo ella meat esek kede parnasato:
Mi sheyyashav benidduy sheloshim yom velo bikkesh lehattiro menaddin oto sheniyya. yashav sheloshim yom acherim velo bikkesh lehattiro machrimin oto:
Bechamma mattirin hannidduy o hacherem. bishlosha afillu hedyotot. veyachid mumche mattir hannidduy o hacherem levaddo. veyesh letalmid lehattir hannidduy o hacherem vaafillu bimkom harav:
Shelosha shenniddu vehalchu lahen vechazar ze middavar shennidduhu biglalo bain shelosha acherim umattirin lo:
Mi shello yada mi shenniddahu yelech lo etzel hannasi veyattir lo nidduyo:
Nidduy al tenay afillu al pi atzmo tzarich hafara. talmid chacham shennidda atzmo vaafillu nidda atzmo al daat peloni vaafillu al davar shechayyav alav nidduy hare ze mefer leatzmo:

Mi shennidduhu bachalom afillu yada mi niddahu tzarich asara bene adam sheshshonin halachot lehattiro minnidduyo. veim lo matza toreach acharehem ad parsa. lo matza mattirim lo afillu asara sheshshonim mishna. lo matza mattirin lo asara sheyyodim likrot battora. lo matza mattirin lo afillu asara sheenan yodin likrot. lo matza bimkomo asara mattirin lo afillu shelosha:

Mi shennidduhu befanav en mattirin lo ella befanav. nidduhu shello befanav mattirin lo befanav veshello befanav. veen ben nidduy lahafara kelum ella menaddin umattirin berega echad kesheyyachazor hamenudde lammutav. veim rau bet din lehanniach ze benidduy kamma shanim mannichin kefi risho. vechen im rau bet din lehacharim laze lechattechilla ulehacharim mi sheyyochal immo veshote immo o mi sheyyaamod immo bearba ammot machrimin kede leyassero uchede laasot seyag lattora ad shello yifretzu hachotim. af al pi sheyyesh reshut lechacham lenaddot lichvodo eno shevach letalmid chacham lehanehig atzmo bedavar ze ella maalim aznav middivre am haaretz velo yashit libbo lahen kainyan sheamar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Kohelet 7 21)</small> "gam lechol haddevarim asher yedabberu al titten libbecha". vechen haya derech chasidim harishonim shomim cherpatam veenan meshivin velo od ella shemmochalim lamcharef vesolchim lo. vachachamim gedolim hayu mishtabbechim bemaasehem hannaim veomrim shemmeolam lo niddu adam velo hechrimuhu lichvodan. vezo hi darkam shel talmide chachamim sherauy lelech bah. bamme devarim amurim keshebbizzahu o cherfahu basseter. aval talmid chacham shebbizzahu o cherfo adam befarhesya asur lo limchol al kevodo veim machal neenash shezze bizyon tora ella nokem venoter haddavar kenachash ad sheyyevakkesh mimmennu mechila veyislach lo:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 1: Asur lehedyot lehanot mikkadshe hashshem. ben middevarim hakkerevin al gabbe hammizbeach. ben mikkadshe bedek habbayit. vechol hannehene bishve peruta mikkadshe hashshem maal:

Devarim shehutteru baachila min hakkarbanot. kegon besar chattat veasham achar zerikat daman o shete hallechem achar zerikat dam shene hakkevasim en bahen meila. afillu achal hazzar meellu vechayyotze bahen. hoil vehen muttarin lemiktzat bene adam lehanot bahen kol hannehene mehen lo maal. vaafillu nifselu veneesru baachila hoil vehayta lahen sheat hetter en chayyavin alehen meila:

Kol hammoel bezadon loke umeshallem ma sheppagam min hakkodesh berosho. veazhara shel meila mizze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "unedarecha". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara laochel mibbesar ola hoil vechullo lashshem. vehu haddin lishar kol kodesh shehu lahashshem levaddo ben mikkadshe hammizbeach ben mikkadshe bedek habbayit im nehene bahen sheve peruta loke. maal bishgaga meshallem ma shennehena vetosefet chomesh. umevi ayil bishne selaim umakrivo asham umitkapper lo vezehu hannikra asham meilot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 15)</small> "vechata bishgaga mikkadshe Adonai vehevi et ashamo" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 5 16)</small> "veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem veet chamishito" vegomer. veshillum hakkeren betosefet chomesh im havaat hakkarban mitzvat ase:
Tashlum hakkeren vahavaat haasham meakkevin hakkappara. veen hachomesh meakkev. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 16)</small> "beel haasham". ayil veasham meakkevin veen hachomesh meakkev:

Hevi meilato ad shello hevi ashamo lo yatza. nistappek lo im maal o lo maal patur min hattashlumin umin hakkarban. vehachomesh hare hu kitchillat hahekdesh veim nehena bo mosif chomesh al hachomesh. uchevar bearnu kamma peamim shehachomesh echad mearbaa min hakkeren ad sheyyihye hu vechumsho chamishsha:
Yesh devarim sheen chayyavin alehen meila middivre tora aval asur lehanot bahen middivre sofrim vehannehene mehen meshallem keren bilvad veeno mosif chomesh veeno mevi asham:

Kol kadshe mizbeach ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim asurin begizza vaavoda shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha". vehu haddin lishar kadashim. vehaggozez et hashshor o haoved batztzon loke min hattora. vetolesh eno kegozez. veyerae li sheeno loke ad sheyyigzoz kede rochav hassit kaful. lo yihye ze chamur mishshabbat:
Sefek kadashim kegon behema shehi sefek bechor vechayyotze bah. hare hen asurin begizza vaavoda vehaggozez o haoved bahen eno loke:

Behemat hekdesh shennafal bah mum venifdat kemo shebbearnu enah mutteret begizza vaavoda vahare hi beissurah ad shettishshachet. nishchata achar pidyonah huttera baachila. bamme devarim amurim keshekkadam hekdeshan et muman o kadam mum over lehekdeshan. aval hammakdish baalat mum kavua lammizbeach enah asura begizza vaavoda ella middivrehem. nifdat hare zo kechullin lechol davar vetetze lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved. chutz min habbechor vehammaaser shehakkedushsha chala al gufan af al pi shehen baale mumin kevuin mittechillatan. veenan yotzin lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved leolam. veasur leharebia bivchor o bifsule hammukdashin:

Muttar litlosh et hassear lechattechilla min hakkadashim kede lehareot hammum lemumche. veoto hassear shettalash o shennashar min habbehema o min habbechor vehammaaser hare ze asur bahanaya afillu leachar sheyyishshachatu mippene muman. gezera shemma yashhe otan hoil veenan bain lechappara. aval tzemer hannosher min hachattat vehaasham muttar bahanaya leachar shechitatan mippene muman. hoil ulechappara hen bain eno mashhe otan. veim nitlash min haola hare ze safek. vechol sheyyittalesh mikkol hakkadashim achar shennafal bahen mum hare hu muttar bahanaya shehare lo talash beyado. chutz min habbechor vehammaaser sheaf hannitlash mimmennu achar shennafal bo mum asur bahanaya:
Hashshochet bechor o shear mukdashin. tolesh et hassear mikkan umikkan laasot makom lassakkin. uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo:
Kadshe bedek habbayit asurin begizza vaavoda middivre sofrim aval min hattora enan asurin. lefichach haggozez otan o haoved bahen eno loke aval makkin oto makkat mardut:

Hammakdish ubbar lammizbeach immo asura baavoda middivre sofrim. mippene sheavodatah machcheshet et haubbar gazru bah. vahare hi mutteret begizza sheen baze hefsed lavvalad. hikdish evar echad min habbehema ben levedek habbayit ben lammizbeach hare haddavar safek im asura kullah begizza vaavoda o enah asura lefichach en lokin aleha:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 2:
Kadashim kallim en moalin bahen ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam moalin beemurehen ad sheyyetzu levet haddeshen shehare hen laishshim veen moalin bedavar hanneechol kemo shebbearnu. afillu heela haemurin shellahen lammizbeach kodem zerika en moalin bahen ad sheyyizzarek haddam. hotzi emurehen lachutz kodem zerika en moalin bahen ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam af al pi sheadayin hen bachutz velo hechziran moalin bahen. shehazzerika moelet layyotze ben lehakel ben lehachemir:
Kol kadshe kadashim moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam moalin bahen bedavar shekkullo laishshim ad sheyyissaref veyetze levet haddeshen veen moalin bedavar hanneechol kemo shebbearnu:
Ketzad haola. echad olat haof veechad olat behema vehakkometz vehallevona uminchat kohanim vehachavitin uminchat nesachim moalin bahen mishsheat hekdeshan ad sheyyetzu achar serefatan al hammizbeach levet haddeshen:
Vechen parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin moalin bahen mishsheat hekdeshan ad sheyyissarfu vetiggamer serefatan bevet haddeshen veyitoch habbasar. aval kodem sheyyitoch moalin bo vehu bevet haddeshen:
Vechen para adumma moalin bah mishshehukdesha ad shettease efer. af al pi shehi kekadshe bedek habbayit hare neemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "chattat hi". utenay bet din hu shello yimol adam beefer happara:
Chattat behema veasham vezivche shalme tzibbur moalim bechullan mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam moalin beemurehen ad sheyyetzu levet haddeshen. veen moalin babbasar. vechen chattat haof moalin bah mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyazze damah. huzza damah en bah meila. aval asur lehanot bemuratah venotzatah. vehannehene bahen achar hazzaya lo maal:
Hammenachot moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu af al pi sheadayin lo nitkaddeshu bichli sharet ad sheyyaktir hakkometz. karav hakkometz hutteru hashsheyarim baachila. veim nifselu hashsheyarim o chasru veachar kach hiktir hakkometz hoil vehaketara zo enah matteret hashsheyarim baachila hare haddavar safek im yatzu yede meila o lo yatzu:
Lechem happanim moalin bo mishshehukdash af al pi sheadayin lo neefa ad sheyyaktir habbezichin. hiktir habbezichin huttar baachila. vechen shete hallechem moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu kodem sheyyeafu ad sheyyizzarek dam hakkevasim. nizrak dam hakkevasim huttar baachila:
Hannesachim moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. yardu lashshitin en moalin bahen. mayim shemmenassechim bechag hassukkot kol zeman shehen bechad shel zahav en nehenin bahen vehannehene lo maal. natnu otan bitzlochit moalin bechullan. shehare hen mikkelal hannesachim:
Log shemen shel metzora moalin bo mishshehukdash bichli ad sheyyizzarek dam haasham. nizrak dam haasham lo nehenin velo moalin ad sheyyittenu mimmennu mattenotav. natnu mimmennu hammattanot hutteru hashsheyarim baachila kivsar chattat veasham:
Kol dame shechitat hakkadashim en moalin bo ben lifne kappara ben leachar kappara ad sheyyetze lenachal kidron. yatza lenachal kidron moalin bo mippene shehaya nimkar legannot vedamav hekdesh. aval hammakkiz dam levehemat kadashim hare hu asur bahanaya umoalin bo. hoil veenah yechola lichyot belo dam hare hu kegufah:
Haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim sheppershu mikkadshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim moalin bahen. pershu leachar zerikat damim en moalin bahen. atzmot haola sheppershu lifne zerika en moalin bahen leachar zerika shehazzerika matteret otam. veim pershu achar zerika moalin bahen leolam. atzmot haola sheppaku meal hammizbeach kodem chatzot hallayla moalin bahen. leachar chatzot en moalin bahen. af al pi sheppaku kodem chatzot kevan shehiggia chatzot hallayla naasu kol haevarim kemi shennitakkelu venaasu efer:
Gachelet sheppaka meal hammizbeach ben lifne chatzot ben leachar chatzot lo nehenin velo moalin. aval gachelet shel kadshe bedek habbayit moalin bah. vehashshalhevet lo nehenin velo moalin:
Deshen hammizbeach hachitzon ben kodem haramat haddeshen ben achar harama moalin bo:
Dishun hammizbeach happenimi vedishun hammenora lo nehenin velo moalin:
Kol behemat kadshe kadashim shehi baalat mum ben shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshah ben shekkadam hekdeshah lemum kavua vaafillu hayta mechussar zeman moalin bahem mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyippadu. aval torin shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannan vehen kadshe mizbeach af al pi sheasur lehanot bahen hannehene lo maal. hoil veenan reuyin lefidyon hare hem kachattaot hammetot lefichach en moalin bahen:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 3:
Kadshe mizbeach shemmetu yatzu mide meila devar tora. aval moalin bahen middivre sofrim. vechen im nifselu bidvarim sheyyippaslu bahen hakkarbanot shekkevar bearnum moalin bahen middivre sofrim. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lahen sheat hetter laachilat kohanim. aval im haya lekadshe kadashim hanneechalim sheat hetter veachar kach nifselu veneesru baachila hoil vehutteru shaa achat en moalin beoto davar shehaya rauy laachila kemo shebbearnu. ketzad. kadshe kadashim shennifselu kodem sheyyaggia haddam lammizbeach kehilchatan kegon sheshshechatan baddarom af al pi shekkibbel batztzafon o sheshshechatan batztzafon vekibbel baddarom. o sheshshachat bayyom vezarak ballayla o sheshshachat ballayla vezarak bayyom. o sheasaan bemachshevet hazzeman o bemachshevet hammakom. o shekkibbelu happesulin et daman af al pi shezzerakuhu kesherim. o shezzerakuhu pesulin af al pi shekkibbeluhu kesherim. o sheyyatza haddam vehabbasar kullo kodem zerikat haddam. o shellan haddam. bechol ellu moalin bechullan leolam shehare lo haya lahen sheat hetter. aval im higgia haddam lammizbeach kemitzvato veachar kach lan habbasar o haemurin. o shennitma habbasar o haemurin. o sheyyatza habbasar o haemurin lachutz. o sheyyatza miktzat habbasar kodem zerikat damim. bechol ellu vechayyotze bahen en moalin bishar besaran shehare haya lo sheat hetter laachila kemo shebbearnu:
Kibbelu happesulin et haddam uzerakuhu vechazru hakkesherim laavoda vekibbelu shear dam hannefesh uzerakuhu en moalin bivsaran. sheen happesulin osin shear dam hannefesh sheyarim chutz min hattame hoil verauy laavodat tzibbur ose shear dam sheyarim:
Ketzad. kibbel hattame vezarak af al pi shechazar hakkasher vekibbel shear dam hannefesh uzerako hare ellu lo hayta lahen sheat hetter umoalin bechullan shezze haddam sheyarim hu veen zerikat hashsheyarim moelet. kevar bearnu sheen bekadashim kallim meila leolam chutz meemurehen achar zerikat haddam vehu shettihye zerika hammoelet. aval kadashim kallim shennitpaggelu af al pi shennizrak haddam en moalin beemurehen. vechen im yatza haddam af al pi shehechziru vezarku en moalin beemurehen:
Kol chattaot hammetot kegon velad chattat utemuratah vechayyotze bahen asur lehanot bahen veim nehena lo maal:
Vechol chattat shettire ad sheyyippol bah mum moalin bah ad shettippade:
Hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shetehen omdot veshachat shetehen keachat vezarak dam achat mehen. en moalin lo bivsar zo shennizrak damah velo bivsar chavertah. veaf al pi sheeno rauy laachila hoil veim ratza mizze zorek veim ratza mizze zorek. aval im shachat zo achar zo en damah moil livsar chavertah vaafillu leachar zerika shehare lo hayta lah shaa haruya lehattir besarah:
Kol chattat of o olat of shennifsela beshinnuy asiyyatah o beshinnuy mekom asiyyatah moalin bah chutz meolat haof shennimlak lematta kimlikat chattat lesham chattat sheaf al pi shello alta labbealim leshem chova en moalin bah hoil veshinna shemah umekom asiyyatah veshinna maaseha leshem davar sheen bo meila:
Mincha shennitpaggela o shennaaset bemachshevet hammakom. vechen shete hallechem velechem happanim shennitpaggelu o shennifselu bemachshevet hammakom. moalin bahen shehare lo hayta lahen sheat hetter:
Vechen kometz sheyyatza lachutz o lan vechazar vehiktiro moalin bashsheyarim shehare lo haya sham sheat hetter. aval im nitma hakkometz vehiktiro en moalin bashsheyarim shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame veeno meratztze lo al hallan velo al hayyotze. yatzu hashsheyarim o nitmeu veachar kach hiktir hakkometz af al pi shehen asurin baachila en moalin bahen shehare karav hakkometz kemitzvato:
Hannehene mikkadshe kadashim kullam lifne zerikat damim. o meemure kadashim kallim leachar zerika. o shennehene min haola kullah o min hakkometz vehallevona uminchat kohanim vehachavitin. yippol ma shennehena lindava. maal bekarbenot hatztzibbur yippol ma shennehena lallishka:
Nehena kodem zerika mibbesar kadshe kadashim shennitma o shennehena meemure kadashim kallim af al pi sheheelan lerosh hammizbeach hare ze patur:
Kadshe hammizbeach chalavan uvetzehen asur lehanot mehen vehannehene lo maal lefichach velad hakkadashim vechen velad hammaaser lo yinak meimmo ella mibbehema acheret chullin. veyesh leadam lehitnaddev velomar chalev behema zo hachullin yihye hekdesh levaldot hakkadashim sheyyinkuhu kede shello yamutu:
Hikdish behema veof lammizbeach kedushshat damim kegon sheamar deme behema zo linsachim udeme ben yona ze lishlamim hare hen kekadshe bedek habbayit umoalin bachalavan uvevetzehen kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 4: Hammafrish maot lechattato leolato ulaashamo uletorin uvene yona moalin bahen mishshaa shehifrish. hifrish lishlamim en moalin bahem:
Hikdish evar echad ledamav lammizbeach. hare ze safek im pashta kedushsha bechullan o lo pashta lefichach tikkarev velo yippade. veim nifda en moalin befidyono:

Hammafrish maot linziruto asur lehanot bahen veim nehena lo maal mippene shehen reuyin lavo kullam shelamim veen bishlamim meila ella beemurehen achar zerikat damim. met yippelu lindava. hayu meforashim deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach velo nehenin velo moalin. deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen. amar ellu lechattati vehashshear linziruti im nehena bechol hashshear maal nehena bemiktzato lo maal. vechen im amar ellu leolati vehashshear linziruti venehena bechullan maal nehena bemiktzatan lo maal sheen bidme shelamim meila. hifrish maot veamar ellu leolati veellu lechattati veellu lishlamim venitarvu moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan. vechetzad yaase. yikkach shalosh behemot umechallel deme chattat bechol makom shehu al hachattat. udeme ola al haola. udeme shelamim al shelamim:
Echad mimmechuyyeve kinin shehifrish maot veamar ellu lechovati moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan veim met yippelu lindava kemo shebbearnu binzirut umoalin bahen:

Hammafrish chattat al achilat chelev veheviah al achilat dam hare ze lo kipper lefichach lo maal. hifrish maot lechattat chelev vekanah bahen chattat dam. beshogeg kipper lefichach maal. bemezid lo kipper lefichach lo maal:

Hammafrish shete selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim lechullin hoil vekanah chullin bidme asham maal. vechayyav leshallem asara dinarim shehen shete selaim vechomesh veyavi bahen asham veyavi karban asham al meilato. lefichach im haya echad mishshene haelim shekkana yafe shete selaim vehashsheni yafe asara dinarin yavi hashshave asara asham tachat hammeila im hachomesh veyavi hashshave shete selaim asham al meilato. lakach echad leasham veechad lechullin im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim yavi oto laashamo harishon. vechen im haya ze hachullin yafe shetayim yavi oto asham meilato shehare maal besela achat middeme haasham vishallem chamishsha dinarim veyippelu lindava:

Hannehene middeme chattat ad shello karva chattato yosif chomesh al ma shennehena veyavi bedamav chattato veyavi karban asham al meilato. vechen im nehena middeme asham ad shello karav ashamo yosif chomesh veyavi bedamav ashamo veyavi asham acher limilato. shekkarbenot hammizbeach meilatan lekarbenot hammizbeach vekadshe bedek habbayit meilatan levedek habbayit. noda lo shemmaal veachar kach karva chattato vaadayin lo hifrish meilato o shehifrishah velo kelalah bidme chattato yolich hammeila vechumshah leyam hammelach. noda lo shemmaal achar shekkarva chattato yippelu meot hammeila vechumshah lindava sheen mafrishin battechilla leibbud. uven kach uven kach yavi asham meilato. uveasham ben shennoda lo shemmaal kodem shekkarav ashamo o achar shekkarav tippol meilato vechumshah lindava mippene shehu kemotar asham veyavi asham meilato:

Hammocher olato ushelamav lo asa kelum. vedin tora sheyyachzeru hammaot chullin kemo shehayu. vekansu oto chachamim sheyyippelu hammaot lindava afillu hayta habbehema shava arbaa umecharah bachamishsha hachamishsha kullan yippelu lindava veen kan meila lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:

Yesh meila bindarim. ketzad. haomer kikkar zo alay karban o hekdesh vaachalah maal af al pi shehi mutteret laacherim. lefichach en lah pidyon shehare enah kodesh ella laze bilvad. amar kikkar zo kodesh o karban vaachalah ben hu ben acher maal lefichach yesh lah pidyon. hayta lefanav kikkar shel hefker veamar kikkar zo hekdesh netalah al menat leachlah maal lefi kullah. al menat lehorishah maal lefi tovat hanaya shebbah:

Haomer lachavero kikkari alecha hekdesh vechazar unetanah lo. hamekabbel mattana zo maal lichsheyyotzi. shehare hannoten enah asura alav. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshear hakkonamot yesh bahen meila lanneesar bahen. vechol devarim hanneesarin alav minneder kaze mitztarfin veim nehena mikkullam bishve peruta maal:

Haomer hannetiot haellu karban im enan niktzatzot hayyom vetallit ze karban im lo tissaref hayyom. veavar hayyom velo niktzetzu velo nisrefa hattallit. hare hem hekdesh veyippadu kishar hahekdeshot veachar kach yehane bahen. aval im amar hare hannetiot haellu karban ad sheyyikkatztzu eno yachol lifdotan. shebbechol et sheyyippadu yachzeru hekdesh ad sheyyikkatztzu vechevan shenniktzetzu enan tzerichin pidyon ella nehenin bahen miyyad. bamme devarim amurim besheppedaan hammakdish. aval im pedaan acher hare ellu yotzin lechullin af al pi sheadayin lo niktzetzu veyihyu muttarin af lammakdish:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 5:
Echad hammakdish levedek habbayit davar harauy lechazzek habbedek kegon even o kora. o hammakdish levedek habbayit davar harauy lammizbeach kegon kevasim vetorim. o hammakdish lammizbeach davar harauy levedek habbayit kegon even vekora. o hammakdish laze velaze devarim sheenan reuyin lo laze velo laze kegon hammakdish tarnegolin vechometz vetzir o karka afillu hikdish ashpa melea zevel o afar o efer. moalin bechullan mishshaa shehukdeshu ad sheyyippadu devarim haruyim lehippadot:
Kol kadshe bedek habbayit im devarim shemmoalin bahen mikkadshe mizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila veim nehena bishve peruta mikkullam maal:
Achal veheechil et chavero o nehena umehanne chavero achilato vahanayat chavero o achilat chavero vahanayato kullan mitztarfin lammeila veim naasa min hakkol hanaya bifruta maal:
Hammeila mitztarefet lizman merubbe. ketzad. nehena hayyom min hahekdesh venehena leachar kamma shanim behelem echad hare ellu mitztarfin lifruta umaal:
En meila ella betalush min hakkarka aval hannehene bakkarka atzmah o bamchubbar lah lo maal afillu pagam. ketzad. hachoresh sede hekdesh o hazzorea bah patur. natal meavakah venehena bah ufegamah maal. haddash bisde hekdesh maal sheheavak shellah moil lassade vahare nehena baavak ufagam hassade. vechen im charash sede hekdesh kede lehaalot avak leesev shennatan bah venatal haesev maal. haddar bimarat hekdesh o betzel ilan o shovach shel hekdesh af al pi shennehena lo maal. vechen hammakdish bayit banuy haddar bo lo maal. aval hammakdish etzim vaavanim uvana bahen bayit haddar sham maal kemo sheyyitbaer:
Giddule hekdesh moalin bahen. ketzad. hikdish sade vehotzia asavim ilan veasa perot moalin bahen. aval hammakdish et habbor rekan veachar kach nitmalle mayim. hikdish ashpa veachar kach nitmallet zevel. shovach venitmalle yonim. hoil veenan giddule hekdesh en moalin bahen. vechen hazzevel vehapperesh shebbachatzar hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin. uma yaasu bahen yimmachru veyippelu demehen lallishka. mayan shehu yotze mittoch sede hekdesh asur lehanot bemayim sheyyotzin mimmennu betoch hassade vehannehene lo maal. yatzu hammayim chutz lassade muttar lehanot bahen. arava haggedela bisde hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin. ilan shel hedyot hassamuch lisde hekdesh vesharashav yotzim betoch hassade. im beno leven hassade shel hekdesh ad shesh esre amma hare otan hashsharashin shebbetoch hassade asurin vehannehene mehen lo maal. haya hailan rachok yeter al shesh esre hannehene bahen maal. ilan shel hekdesh hassamuch lisde hedyot vesharashav yotzin betoch hassade im haya betoch shesh esre amma moalin bahen. haya rachok yeter al shesh esre amma otan hashsharashin shebbetoch hassede hedyot lo nehenin velo moalin:
Ken shebbarosh hailan shel hekdesh shebbana otan haof meetzim vaasavim vechayyotze bahen. kol hakken im habbetzim shebbo im haefrochim hatztzerichin leimman en nehenin bahen vehannehene lo maal:
Hammakdish et hayyaar moalin bechullo ben bailanot ben bechol ken shebberosh hailanot o shebbenehen:
Gizbarim sheshshafu atze hekdesh vekatztzu otan moalin beotan haetzim hakketannim shechatchu meet shekkatztzu. aval en moalin lo bashshippuy velo bannesoret velo banneviyya shel etzim vehu hagguf hakkashe heagol shebbetoch haetz haddome leyabbelet shello yitzlach limlacha:
Hammakdish avdo en moalin bo velo bisaro af al pi shehu omed lehiggazez mippene shehu mechubbar lo vechol zeman shehu mechubbar holech umashbiach:
Hazzorea perot hekdesh pode otan bishat ziran. veaf al pi shello pada hare haggiddulin chullin veen moalin bahen veen meshallemin mehen keren vechomesh vechayyavin bechalla:
Shemarim shel hekdesh shennatan alehem mayim. rishon vesheni ushelishi asur lehanot bo vehannehene lo maal. revii muttar. bamme devarim amurim bekadshe bedek habbayit. aval kadshe mizbeach af mervii veelach leolam asur:
Hammakdish tarnegolet lammizbeach moalin bah uvevetzatah. hikdish chamor lammizbeach moalin bah uvachalavah. hikdish torim levedek habbayit moalin bahen uvevetzatan kemo shebbearnu:
Katnot kehunna shebbalu moalin bahen kishar kadashim. vehachadashim hoil venittenu lehanot bahen en moalin bahen:
Kadshe akkum im levedek habbayit hikdishu moalin bahen. veim kadshe mizbeach hen en bahen meila min hattora shenneemar bakkarbanot <small>(Vayikra 1 2)</small> "dabber el bene yisrael". aval asur lehanot bahen middivre sofrim:
Kol umare vereach shel hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin. bamme devarim amurim kesheheriach bakketoret achar shealta hattimmoret. aval im heriach bakketoret keshettaale timratah maal:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 6:
Yesh devarim shehaadam nehene bahen velo yippagmu kegon hammishtammesh bichli zahav tahor. veyesh devarim sheyyippagmu kegon begadim uchele kesef unechoshet uvarzel vechayyotze bahen. vehannehene bishve peruta min hahekdesh sheeno mechubbar bakkarka im nehene bedavar sheen bo pegam kegon shennishtammesh bichli zahav shel hekdesh maal. nehene bedavar shennifgam kegon shellavash bigde hekdesh o baka bekordom lo maal ad sheyyifgom bahekdesh bishve peruta beoto davar atzmo shennehena bo veyitkavven lehanot veyifgom veyehane keachat. nehena bechachatzi peruta ufagam bechachatzi peruta o shennehena bishve peruta ufagam bishve peruta bedavar acher velo nehena bema sheppagam velo pagam bema shennehena hare ze lo maal ad sheyyehane bishve peruta veyifgom beotah hanaya bishve peruta baddavar atzmo. ketzad. hare shehittir matlit mibbeged hekdesh utefarah bevigdo ulevashah venehena bah bishve peruta vehifsid babbeged shehittirah mimmenna bishve peruta velo hifsid bammatlit kelum hare ze lo maal mippene shennehena bedavar echad ufagam bedavar acher. uchevar bearnu shehannehene umehanne chavero mitztaref vaafillu lizman merubbe:
Kadshe kadashim hattemimim shettalash mitztzimran. kevan shennehena bifruta maal af al pi shello pagam. shehare hen domim lechos shel zahav sheeno nifgam sheen telishat hatztzemer poselet otan millikkarev. aval im nafal bahen mum hoil velimchira omdim vehaggizza pogemet demehen lo maal ad sheyyehane veyifgom bifruta. talash mehen achar shemmetu kevan shennehena maal sheen pegam lemeta. umeila zo middivrehem kemo shebbearnu:
Hammoel bekadshe bedek habbayit kevan shemmaal bishgaga nitchallel hekdesh veze shennehena acharav patur. maal bezadon hoil veeno chayyav bekarban meila lo nitchallel hekdesh ella hare hu bahavayato veim ba acher venehena bo bishgaga maal. bamme devarim amurim keshemmaal bakkodesh vehotzio betorat chullin vehiknahu leacher. aval im nehena bo ufegamo velo hikna leacher yesh bo moel achar moel:
Veen moel achar moel bemukdashim. ella bivhema uchele tashmish bilvad. ketzad. baka bekordom shel hekdesh venehena bifruta ufagam uva chavero uvaka bo venehena ufagam kullam maalu. natal hakkordom unetano lachavero hu maal aval chavero lo maal. shata bechos shel zahav venehena bifruta uva chavero veshata venehena uva chavero veshata venehena kullam maalu. natal hakkos unetano lachavero mattana o mecharo hu maal vachavero lo maal. rachav al gabbe hachamor venehena bifruta ufagam uva chavero verachav alav venehena ufagam uva chavero verachav alav venehena ufagam. kullam maalu. natan hachamor lachavero mattana o mecharo o hiskiro hu maal vachavero lo maal. vechen hammashil kardom shel hekdesh hu maal lefi tovat hanaa shebbo vachavero muttar livkoa bo lechattechilla. vehu haddin livhema:
Behemat kadshe mizbeach enah ken ella yesh bah moel achar moel ad kamma peamim. ketzad. talash min hachattat uva chavero vetalash uva chavero vetalash kullan maalu. vechen im netanah lachavero vachavero lachavero kullan maalu. veyerae li sheddin hammenachot vehaofot vehannesachim uchele sharet kedin habbehema shekkullan kedushshat hagguf hen:
Behemat kadshe hakkadashim shennafal bah mum hoil vehi omedet lefidyon hare hu kekadshe bedek habbayit shehi kedushshat damim. veim netanah lachavero vachavero lachavero harishon bilvad maal:
Amru chachamim shehannotel even o kora shel hekdesh unetanah lachavero shenehem maalu. veim netanah leze haggizbar shehayta tachat yado hu maal vehaggizbar lo maal. veyerae li sheen ellu haddevarim amurim ella bemoel bezadon shehare lo nitchallel hekdesh. hannotel peruta shel hekdesh al daat shehi shello lo maal ad sheyyotzi otah bachafatzav o ad sheyyitten otah bemattana. netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal. sheen moel achar moel bishar hekdeshot kemo shebbearnu vechol kayyotze baze:
Natal even o kora shel hekdesh lo maal shehare lo nehena adayin. bana otah betoch beto maal. netanah al gabbe challon shebbattikra velo chibberah lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha bishve peruta sheen zo hanaya hannikkeret:
Natal peruta shel hekdesh unetanah levallan af al pi shello rachatz maal shehare nehena bihyoto rochetz bechol et sheyyirtze. vechen im netanah leechad mibbaale ummanuyyot maal af al pi sheadayin lo asu melachto:
Kana bah chefetz velo mashach im min haakkum maal. veim min yisrael lo maal:
Hammotzi meot hekdesh bitzrachav al daat shehen chullin af al pi shello hotzian bedivre chol maal. ketzad. hammevi chattato vaashamo ufischo min hahekdesh vechen mechussar kappara shehevi kapparato min hahekdesh maal. vechullam en moalin ad sheyyizzarek haddam. lefichach hammevi menachot unesachim velechem toda min hahekdesh af al pi sheavar avera lo maal sheen kan zerikat dam lechapper alav:
Natan shiklo mimmeot hekdesh kesheyyitremu hatteruma veyiknu mimmenna afillu behema achat veyizzarek damah yimol hashshokel. shehare chalku beotah habbehema shennizrak damah:
Hammafrish shiklo vehotzio bishar tzerachav. ben hu ben chavero maal. netano lachavero leshaklo al yado halach ushekalo al yede atzmo im kevar nitrema hatteruma maal hashshokel shehattorem torem al heatid lehiggavot kemo shebbearnu bishkalim ucheillu higgia shekel ze lallishka ulefichach maal. veim adayin lo nitrema teruma lo maal. uleolam en moalin bishyare hallishka:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 7:
Mi sheshshagag velakach hekdesh o meot hekdesh unetano leshaliach lehotzio betorat chullin. im asa hashshaliach shelichuto hameshalleach hu shemmaal. veim lo asa shelichuto ella asa hashshaliach middaat atzmo hashshaliach hu shemmaal. ketzad. baal habbayit sheamar lishlucho ten (li) meoto basar laorchin halach venatan lahen kikkar. o sheamar lo ten lahen kikkar venatan lahen basar. amar lishlucho have li min hachallon vehevi lo min hammigdal. o sheamar lo have min hammigdal vehevi lo min hachallon. hashshaliach maal. vechen kol kayyotze baze. halach hashshaliach vehevi min hachallon kemo sheamar lo af al pi sheamar hashsholeach lo haya belibbi sheyyavi ella min hammigdal baal habbayit maal. shehare asa shelichut maamaro udevarim shebballev enan devarim. vaafillu haya hashshaliach cheresh o shote o katan sheen lahen shelichut im asa kemaamaro baal habbayit maal veim lo asa shelichuto baal habbayit patur. amar lishlucho ten laorchin chaticha chaticha shel basar halach hashshaliach veamar lahen tolu shetayim shetayim. baal habbayit maal shehare naasa devaro vehashshaliach patur mippene shehu mosif al shelichut baal habbayit velo akar hashshelichut. aval im amar lahem hashshaliach tolu shetayim shetayim middati shenehen maalu. natlu haorchim shalosh shalosh af haorchin maalu mippene shekkol echad mehen asa shelichut chavero vehosif middato. nimtza chavero chayyav lefi shennaasu devarav velo neekra hashshelichut vehu chayyav al ze shehosif middato:
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu hachatichot mikkadshe bedek habbayit. aval im hayu besar ola vechayyotze bo lo maal ella haochel bilvad shehare hu chayyav beissur acher yeter al hammeila. uvechol hattora kullah en shaliach lidvar avera ella bimila levaddah shello yitarev immah issur acher:
Hannoten perutat hekdesh lishlucho veamar lo have li bechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot. halach vehevi lo bechullah nerot o bechullah petilot. o sheamar lo have li bechullah nerot o bechullah petilot halach vehevi bechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot shenehem peturim. baal habbayit lo maal shehare lo naasa shelichuto bifruta. vehashshaliach lo maal shehare lo akar shelichuto bifruta. aval im amar lo have li bechetzyah nerot mimmakom peloni uvechetzyah petilot mimmakom peloni vehalach vehevi nerot mimmekom petilot ufetilot mimmekom nerot hashshaliach maal:
Natan lo shete perutot veamar lo have li etrog vehalach vehevi lo bifruta etrog uvifruta rimmon. hashshaliach maal uvaal habbayit patur shehare shelacho liknot lo etrog sheshshave shete perutot. lefichach im haya haetrog shehevi lo bifruta achat shave shete perutot shenehem maalu:
Hashsholeach peruta beyad shelucho liknot lo bah chefetz venizkar baal habbayit shehi hekdesh kodem shettaggia leyad hachenvani hashshaliach maal shehu shogeg uvaal habbayit kevar nizkar veen hammezid chayyav bekarban meila kemo shebbearnu. nizkar af hashshaliach veyada shehi hekdesh kodem shettaggia lachenvani shenehem peturim mikkarban meila vehachenvani chayyav kesheyyotzi otah peruta shennitarva bimotav shehare hu shogeg. hodiu lechenvani shepperuta shennatnu lo hekdesh shelashtan peturin venitpas hammikkach lahekdesh:
Vechetzad yaase kede lehatztzil hachenvani min hachet ad sheyyihye muttar lehishtammesh bechol hammaot. notel peruta shel chullin o keli kol shehu veomer peruta shel hekdesh bechol makom shehi mechullelet al ze. vetease otah peruta o hakkeli hekdesh veyuttar hachenvani lehishtammesh bechol hammaot. vechen peruta shel hekdesh shennitarva bechol hakkis o sheamar peruta bechis ze hekdesh. mechallel otah veachar kach yishtammesh bakkis. veim hotzi velo chillel lo maal ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis:
Amar kis mikkisay hekdesh veshor mishshevaray hekdesh. moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan. ketzad ose. mevi et haggadol shebbahem veomer im hekdesh hu hare hu hekdesh veim lav hahekdesh bechol makom shehu mechullal al ze. vihanne bakkatan:
Hammoel befachot mishsheve peruta ben bezadon ben bishgaga meshallem et hakkeren veeno chayyav chomesh velo karban. veyerae li sheeno loke al pachot mishsheve peruta im haya mezid:
Hammafkid maot etzel baal habbayit venishtammesh bahen vehotzi. baal habbayit maal. shehare en lo reshut lehishtammesh bahen uvaal happikkadon lo hirshahu:
Hifkidan etzel shulchani o chenvani velo hayu chatumin velo keshurin kesher meshunne hoil veyesh lo reshut min haddin lehishtammesh bahen im hotziu shenehen peturin. baal happikkadon patur shehare lo amar lo hishtammesh bahen. vehachenvani patur mippene sheenan keshurin kesher meshunne velo chatumin ucheillu hishtammesh birshut:
Haishsha shehichnisa maot shel hekdesh levalah. o shehikdish morishah umet venaflu lah hekdeshot birushsha. lichsheyyotzi habbaal hammaot bachafatzav yimol:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 8:
Happoalim shehen osin behekdesh af al pi sheppasku immahen mezonot lo yochlu miggerogarot shel hekdesh veim achlu maalu. ella hahekdesh noten lahem deme mezonot:
Haddash karshine hekdesh hare ze chosem et happara. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 4)</small> "lo tachsom shor bedisho" dayish harauy lo:
En mechallelin et hahekdesh al hammelacha ella al hammaot. ketzad. umman sheasa melacha behekdesh bemane en notnin lo behemat hekdesh o tallit hekdesh bischaro ad shemmechallelin otan al hammaot. veachar sheyyeasu chullin notnin otan laumman bischaro im ratzu. vechozrin velokchin mimmennu behema mitterumat hallishka:
Keshebbonin bammikdash en lokchin etzim vaavanim min hahekdesh velo bonin et habbinyan al daat shehu kodesh ella bonin hakkol min hachol. gezera shemma yehane betzel habbinyan o yishshaen al even o kora bishat melacha. veachar sheyyushlam habbinyan mechallelin meot hahekdesh al habbinyan. veim tzarchu haggizbarin leetzim lakkodesh leoto hayyom bilvad lokchin otan mimmeot hahekdesh shehare enan mitacharin yamim kede shennachush lahen shemma yishshaen adam alehen veyimol:
Keshepposkin im haummanin livnot bammikdash uvaazarot. poskin immahen kach vechach amma bechach vechach sela beamma bat esrim etzba. ucheshemmoshchin lahen ma shebbanu moshchin umechashshevin lahen beamma gedola bat esrim vearba etzbaot kede shello yavou lide meila mippene sheen medakdekin bimshicha:
Tenay bet din sheyyihyu hakkohanim neotin bammelach uvaetzim baachilat karbanot sheochlin bechelkan. aval lo yittenu melach hammikdash bechullin shellahen:
Melach sheal gabbe haevar moalin bo. sheal gabbe hakkevesh vesheal rosh hammizbeach en moalin bo:
Rauy laadam lehitbonen bemishpete hattora hakkedosha veleda sof inyanam kefi kocho. vedavar shello yimtza lo taam velo yeda lo illa al yehi kal beenav velo yaharos laalot el Adonai pen yifrotz bo. velo tehe machashavto bo kemachshavto bishar divre hachol. bo uree kamma hechmira tora bimila. uma im etzim vaavanim veafar vaefer kevan shennikra shem adon haolam alehem bidvarim bilvad nitkaddeshu vechol hannoheg bahen minhag chol maal bah vaafillu haya shogeg tzarich kappara. kal vachomer lemitzvot shechakak lanu hakkadosh baruch hu shello yivat haadam bahen mippene shello yeda taman. velo yechappe devarim asher lo ken al hashshem velo yachshov bahen machshavto kedivre hachol. hare neemar battora <small>(Vayikra 19 37)</small> <small>(Vayikra 20 22)</small> "ushemartem et kol chukkotay veet kol mishpatay vaasitem otam". amru chachamim litten shemira vaasiyya lachukkim kammishpatim. vehaasiyya yedua vehi sheyyaase hachukkim. vehashshemira sheyyizzaher bahen velo yedamme shehen pechutin min hammishpatim. vehammishpatim hen hammitzvot shettaman galuy vetovat asiyyatan baolam hazze yedua kegon issur gezel ushefichut damim vechibbud av vaem. vehachukkim hen hammitzvot sheen taman yadua. amru chachamim chukkim chakkoti lecha veen lecha reshut lehareher bahen. veyitzro shel adam nokfo bahen veummot haolam meshivin alehen kegon issur besar chazir uvasar bechalav veegla arufa ufara adumma vesair hammishtalleach. vechamma haya david hammelech mitztaer min hamminim umin haakkum shehayu meshivin al hachukkim. vechol zeman shehayu rodfin oto bitshuvot hashsheker sheorchin lefi kotzer daat haadam haya mosif devekut battora. shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 119 69)</small> "taflu alay sheker zedim ani bechol lev etztzor pikkudecha". veneemar sham bainyan <small>(Tehillim 119 86)</small> "kol mitzvotecha emuna sheker redafuni azreni". vechol hakkarbanot kullan mikkelal hachukkim hen. amru chachamim shebbishvil avodat hakkarbanot haolam omed. shebbaasiyyat hachukkim vehammishpatim zochin hayesharim lechayye haolam habba. vehikdima tora tziuuy al hachukkim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 5)</small> "ushemartem et chukkotay veet mishpatay asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem".
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 1: Shiva mine kelim hen shemmekabbelin tuma min hattora veellu hen. habbegadim. vehassakkin. uchele or. uchele etzem. uchele mattachot. uchele etz. uchele cheres. hare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "mikkol keli etz o veged o or o sak". uvichle mattachot neemar <small>(Bamidbar lo 22)</small> "ach et hazzahav veet hakkasef". uvichle cheres neemar "ucheli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho kol asher betocho yitma veoto tishboru":

Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Bamidbar lo 20)</small> "vechol maase izzim" lerabbot kelim haasuyin min hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim umin haatzamot shel izzim vehu haddin lishar mine behema vechayya. aval kelim haasuyin meatzmot haof enan mekabbelin tuma chutz mikkelim haasuyin mikkenaf haazniyya bilvad uvetzat hannaamit hametzuppa hoil vehen domin leetzem mekabbelin tuma kichle etzem. vekarov beenay shettumatan middivre sofrim:

Kelim haasuyin meatzmot chayya shebbayyam umeorah tehorim. kol shebbayyam tahor veeno mekabbel tuma min hattumot velo tumat midras. af haoreg beged mitztzemer haggadel bayyam eno mekabbel tuma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "o veged o or" mippi hashshemua lamdu ma beged min haggadel baaretz af or min haggadel baaretz. chibber min haggadel bayyam im haggadel baaretz afillu chut o meshicha im chibbero chibbur ad shemmesim et shenehen keillu hen echad letuma sheim nitma ze yitma ze hakkol mekabbel tuma:

Yerae li shehakkelim haasuyim meor haof en mekabbelin tuma kemo atzmotav. veim tomar vahare hu kasher lichtov alav tefillin keor behema vechayya. hinne or haddag eno mekabbel tuma velule zuhamato sheenah poseket haya kasher lattefillin hinne lamadta sheaf davar sheeno mekabbel tuma kasher litfillin im en lo zuhama:

Kele zechuchit enan mekabbelin tuma middivre tora vachachamim gazru alehen sheyyekabbelu tuma hoil utechillat beriyyatan min hachol kichle cheres hare hen kichle cheres. umippene shettochan nire kevaran lo gazru alehen sheyyittammeu meaviran ella ad shettigga hattuma bahen ben mittochan ben miggabban kichle mattachot. velo gazru tuma al peshutehen ella al mekabbelehen. veen lahem tohora bemikve. veen sorfin alehen teruma vekadashim shello gazru alehen ella litlot:
Kele gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama leolam tehorin. veen mekabbelin tuma min hattumot velo tumat midras lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim ben peshutehen ben mekabbelehen:
Pil shebbala hutzin vehekian derech hari haose mehen kelim hare hen safek im hem kichle gelalim o kele etz keshehayu. aval kefifa shennitmet uvelaah pil vehekiah derech bet hari hare hi betumatah:

Peshute kele cheres kegon menora vechisse veshulchan shel cheres vechayyotze bahen en mekabbelin tuma min hattumot velo tumat midras lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "asher yippol mehem el tocho" <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "yitma" kol sheyyesh lo toch bichli cheres mekabbel tuma vesheen lo toch tahor:

Kele mattachot echad peshutehen kegon hassakkinim vehammisparayim o mekabbelehen kegon hayyorot vehakkumekumosin hakkol mekabbelin tuma shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar lo 23)</small> "kol davar asher yavo vaesh" ben mekabbel ben pashut. afillu teva o migdal vechayyotze bahen shel mattechet shehen mekabbelin arbaim sea belach o yeter mekabbelin tuma shenneemar kol davar asher yavo vaesh:

Kele etz uchele or uchele etzem mekabbelehen kegon haareva vehachemet vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma middivre tora. aval peshutehen kegon halluchot vehakkisse vehaor sheochlin alav vechayyotze bahen enan mekabbelin tuma ella middivre sofrim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "mikkol keli etz" mippi hashshemua lamdu ma sak sheyyesh lo bet kibbul af kol sheyyesh lo bet kibbul. uchele etzem kichle etz lechol davar. bamme devarim amurim shettumat peshutehen middivre sofrim bishar tumot chutz mittumat midras. aval bemidras hazzav vachaverav mittammein min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 4)</small> "kol hammishkav asher yishkav" kol heasuy lemishkav o lemerkav kemo shebbearnu. vechen keli zechuchit heasuy lemishkav mittamme bemidras middivrehen:
Kol shehu arug ben mitztzemer ufishtim ben mikkanbos o mimmeshi o mishshear devarim haggedelim bayyabbasha hu hannikra beged leinyan tuma. vehallevadim kivgadim lechol davar:

Hassak hu chute sear haggedulin keshalshelet o haarugin kivgadim echad heasuy min haizzim o mitztzemer gemallim o mizzenav hassus vehappara vechayyotze bahen veechad haarig mehen kemo hammartzufin o haggadul kemo chevek shel chamor vechayyotze bo. aval hachavalim vehammeshichot hashshezurin ben min hassear ben mitztzemer ufishtim enan mekabbelin tuma bifne atzman:

Kol hakkelim haasuyin min haggome umin haarava umin hakkanim umikkappot temarim umin healim vehassarigin ukelippe ilanot umin hachelef kegon hakkefifot vehatteraskelin vehammachalatzot vehammappatzot hakkol bichlal kele haetz shehakkol gadel min haaretz keetz. echad keli cheres veechad keli neter lechol davar. kol keli heasuy meheafar min haafarot veachar kach sorfin otan bechivshan hare ze keli cheres. vehattannur vehakkirayim vehakkuppach vechayyotze bahen mishshear habbinyanot sheofin bahen o mevashshelin bahen hakkol mekabbelin tuma din tora vetumatan vetumat keli cheres shava:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 2:
Haose keli kibbul mikkol makom hare ze mekabbel tuma bechol shehu min hattora. veen lichli kibbul shiur. vehu sheyyaase davar shel kayyama sheefshar sheyyaamod. ketzad. haose keli min haor hammatztza shello nitabbed kelal. o min hanneyar af al pi sheen hanneyar mekabbel tuma. o mikkelippat harimmon vehaegoz vehaallon afillu chakakum hattinokot lamod bahen et heafar. o shehitkinum lechaf moznayim. hare ellu mekabbelin tuma. shettinok cheresh shote vekatan yesh lahen maase af al pi sheen lahen machashava. aval haose kelim min hallefet vehaetrog vehaddelaat hayeveshim shechakakan lamod bahen vechol kayyotze bahen. hare hen tehorin lefi shei efshar sheyyaamdu ella zeman muat: 
Kene moznayim vehammachak sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul mattechet. vehaesel sheyyesh bo bet kibbul maot. vekane shel etz sheyyesh bo bet kibbul mayim. umakkel sheyyesh bo bet kibbul mezuza o mekom margalit. umashchezet shel etz sheyyesh bo bet kibbul shemen. veluach pinkas sheyyesh bo bet kibbul shaava. kol ellu vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehen peshute kele etz hoil veyesh bahen bet kibbul kol shehu mekabbelin tuma din tora. veen tame min hattora ella bet kibbul levaddo sheyyesh bahen vehameshammesh et bet hakkibbul mishshear hakkeli shebbet hakkibbul tzarich lo. aval hayyater al hatztzorech mishshear hakkeli happashut tahor min hattora vetame middivrehen kemo shebbearnu: 
Bet kibbul heasuy lemalleoto eno bet kibbul. ketzad. bekaat shel etz shechokkin bah bet kibbul vetokin bo hassaddan shel barzel. im shel nappachim hi enah mekabbelet tuma sheaf al pi sheyyesh bah bet kibbul lo naasa ella lemalleoto. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veim hayta shel tzorfin hare zo mekabbelet tuma mippene shehen magbihin et habbarzel bechol et sheyyirtze umekabbetzin et sefot hazzahav vehakkesef hammitkabbetzet sham tachat hassaddan vahare naasa lekabbala. vechen kol kayyotze bo: 
Hakkaf hechakuk shettachat ragle hammittot vehammigdalot vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehu mekabbel tahor veen bo mishshum keli kibbul lefi sheeno asuy lekibbul ella lismoch bo bilvad. shefoferet hakkash mekabbelet tuma kechol kele haetz shemmekabbelin tuma afillu enah yechola lekabbel ella tippa achat. ushefoferet hakkane shechatachah lekabbala enah mekabbelet tuma ad sheyyotzi et kol hallavan shebbetochah. veim lo nechtecha lekabbala hare hi kifshute kele etz. aval shefoferet shel pakuot vechayyotze bahen enan kelim ella koochalin hen chashuvin: 
Shefoferet shechatachah venatan bah et hammezuza veachar kach netanah bechotel afillu natna shello kederech kabbalatah mekabbelet tuma. kevaah bakkotel im kevaah kederech kabbalatah hare zo mekabbelet tuma. shello kederech kabbalatah tehora. natan hashshefoferet bakkotel veachar kach natan bah hammezuza im hayta kederech kabbalatah hare zo mekabbelet tuma. shello kederech kabbalatah tehora. kevaah bakkotel afillu kederech kabbalatah tehora: 
Keli sheorgin oto min hannesarim o min hashshaam kede sheyyishtechu alav habbegadim vehammugmar millematta kede sheyyitbassemu im haya asuy kechavveret sheen lo karka tahor veim haya bo bet kabbalat kesut hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Sandal shel behema shel mattechet tame veshel shaam tahor sheen ze chashuv mikkele hakkabbala: 
Hatztzorer margalit baor vehotziah venishar mekomah amok hare ze mekabbel tuma ad sheyyifshot. shekkol kele kibbul mekabbelin bechol shehen vahare mekoman kemo kis katan. aval tzeror hammaot eno mekabbel tuma sheen alav tzurat keli:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 3:
Kol keli etz heasuy lenachat afillu eno mekabbel ella davar muat eno mekabbel tuma lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim. vechol keli etz heasuy lehittaltel male verekan kesak afillu haya machazik mea sea veaf al pi sheyyesh lo shulayim hoil veeno asuy lenachat hare ze mekabbel tuma din tora kishar kele kibbul. vechol keli etz shehu setam im hayu lo shulayim leshev alehem al hakkarka kede shello yehe noach lehitgalgel vehaya machazik arbaim sea belach shehen korayim beyavesh eno mekabbel tuma kelal lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim mippene shechezkato sheasuy lenachat. udevarim ellu divre kabbala hen. mippi hashshemua lamdu ma sak shehu mittaltel male verekan af keli etz lo yitma ella im ken haya mittaltel male verekan lehotzi keli etz heasuy lenachat: 
Hakkelim shechezkatan shehen asuyin lenachat kegon shidda teva umigdal vechavveret hakkash vechavveret hakkanim uvor sefina gedola vechayyotze beellu. im hen machazikin arbaim sea en mekabbelin tuma. veellu hen hakkelim shel etz shehen asuyin lehittaltel bimloan. dirdur shemmannichin oto al haagala vekostot hammelachim vaarevat haabbedan uvor sefina ketanna sheenah yechola lehallech beemtza hayyam haggadol vehaaron. kol echad mechameshet kele etz ellu af al pi shehen mekabbelin yoter mearbaim sea hare ellu mekabbelin tuma shello naasu mittechillatan ella lehittaltel melein. ushear kol kele etz im hayu mekabbelin arbaim sea veyesh lahem shulayim chezkatan sheenan asuyin lehittaltel bimloan ulefichach en mekabbelin tuma. vechen kele etzem uchele haor hamekabbelin arbaim sea belach en mekabbelin tuma ella im ken naasu mittechillatan keshehen melein: 
Hashshidda vehatteva vehammigdal shel zechuchit habbaim bemidda tehorin ushear kele zechuchit af al pi shemmekabbelin arbaim sea hare hen mekabbelin tuma. veze chomer bichle zechuchit mibbichle etz: 
Kol keli sheyyesh beshibburo amma al amma berum shalosh hare hu machazik arbaim sea belach. ucheshemmoddin et hakkeli moddin oto mibbachutz im haya bo amma al amma berum shalosh af al pi sheen tocho ella pachot mizze hare hu tahor sheen ovi haddefanot memaet. aval ovi haraglayim voovi hazzer im haya lo zer en nimdadin immo: 
Haya betoch hakkeli teva ketanna kegon mucheni shebbetoch hashshidda bizman shehi nishmetet enah nimdedet immah veenah chibbur lah veenah matztzelet immah beohel hammet. veim enah nishmetet nimdedet immah vahare hen kichli echad: 
Haya lakkeli kissuy kamur bizman shehu kavua nimdad immo. eno kavua eno nimdad immo. hayu bo megurot mibbifnim nimdedet immo. veim hayu mibbachutz enan nimdadot immo: 
Keli etz sheeno mekabbel arbaim sea kedarko ella im ken hittahu al tziddo o semacho bedavar acher hoil umekabbel arbaim sea mikkol makom tahor: 
Hashshidda vehatteva shennittela achat meraglehen af al pi shello nikkevu ella hare hen mekabbelin hare ellu tehorin vaadayin yesh lahem shulayim vechezkatan shehen lenachat keshehayu:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 4: Shalosh middot bichle etz sheenan asuyin lekabbala. kol keli etz heasuy letashmish adam bilvad kegon hassullam tahor veeno mekabbel tuma kelal velo ribbuhu chachamim letuma. vechol keli etz heasuy letashmish hakkelim vehaadam kegon hashshulchan vehattavla vehammitta vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma. uminnayin shehen letashmish adam vetashmish meshammeshav shehare manniach hakkearot al hashshulchan vehakkosot al hattavla vehammatztzaot al hammitta. vechol keli etz heasuy letashmish hakkelim bilvad shehare hu meshammesh meshammeshe adam im lo haya meshammesh et hakkelim ella bishat melacha bilvad hare ze tahor mikkelum kegon menora shel etz shemmeshammeshet hanner bishat hadelaka, vechan vehu keli shemmannichin tachat hakkelim bishat melacha, vehaddefusin kullan. veim haya meshammesh et hakkelim bishat melacha veshello bishat melacha hare ze mekabbel tuma kegon kissuy hakkafatza vechayyotze bo vetik hassayif vehassakkin veharomach vehammisparim vehattaar vehammichchol vehammichtav uvet hakkochal vetik tavla usekuretiya uvet hachitztzim uvet happagozot vetik chalalim kol ellu vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheenan ella meshammeshe kelim mekabbelin tuma shehare hakkeli tzarich lahen bishat melacha veshello bishat melacha. aval kissuy kamatra vechissuy teva vechissuy teni vehammachbesh shel charash vehakkisse shettachat hatteva vehakkematin shellah vehakkelev shebbonin alav tik hassappar uvet hanneger vehammanul vehammezuza vetik nevalim vehakkinnorot vehakkelev shel godle mitznefet udefus shel tefillin vesus shel etz shel zemer shemmesachakin bo ureviit hammekonenet ugenonat heani vesamochot hammitta venaklite hammitta vachamor shettachat hammitta kol ellu vechayyotze bahen tehorin mippene shehen meshammeshe hakkelim bishat melacha bilvad:

Malben hammitta im haya melubbash befikot veyesh lo raglayim shemmechabberan im hammitta hare ze mittamme im hammitta shehare notnin oto bifne hammitta vahare hu keechad meevareha. netano al shete leshonot vahare hu gavoah al hammitta af al pi shemmesorag bachavalim hoil veen lo raglayim tahor mippene shehu mimmeshammeshe hakkelim bishat melacha bilvad kemalbene bene levi shettolin bahem kinnorotehen uchele hashsher shehen tehorin:

Machbesh shel shekaf shemmoteach alav et haor tahor mippene shemmanniach alav et haeven bammakom hechakuk sheyyesh bo umeshammesh alav venimtza asuy leshammesh et hakkelim bishat melacha veeno mittamme mishshum kibbul shehare hechakak shebbo asuy lehitmalleot beeven:

Chippuye hammitta tehorin vechen kol hachippuyin ben shehayu shel etz o shel etzem o shel or o shel mattechet tehorin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "asher yease melacha bahen" perat lechippuye hakkelim. vechen kele etz o etzem sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul shetztzippam bemattechet tehorim veen mekabbelin tuma meachar shetztzippam bittelan vehatztzippuy atzmo tahor kemo shebbearnu:

Haose keli miktzato min haetz umiktzato min hammattechet im haya haetz meshammesh hammattechet mekabbel tuma veim hayta hammattechet meshammeshet et haetz hakkol tahor. ketzad. mafteach shel etz veshinnav mimmattechet afillu shen echad hare ze mekabbel tuma. hayta hi mimmattechet veshinnayim shello meetz hakkol tahor:
Tabbaat shel mattechet vechotamah shel almog temea. hayta shel almog vechotamo shel mattechet hare zo enah mekabbelet tuma:

Hashshen shel mattechet o hachotam mekabbel tuma bifne atzmo im lo haya mechubbar laetz. vechen hameabbed vehammazre vehammagov vehammasrek shel rosh shennittela echad mishshinnehen vaasaah shel mattechet hare ellu mekabbelin tuma:
Makkel sheasa berosho masmer kemin rimmon kede sheyyihye ochez bo eno mekabbel tuma. asaahu shello tihye haaretz ochelet et haetz mekabbel tuma:
Vechen makkel shekkava bo masmerim kede lehakkot bo mekabbel tuma shennimtza haetz meshammesh et hammattechet. asaan lenoy eno mekabbel tuma shehare hammattechet meshammeshet et haetz:
Vechen menakkiyyot shel mattechet shekkevaan bammakkel o baddelet lenoy tehorot. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshear hakkelim:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 5:
Kol hakkelim en mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan. uchele etz meematay mekabbelin tuma. hammitta vehaarisa mishsheyyeshufem beor haddag. gamar shello lashuf mekabbelin tuma. hassallim shel etz mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot ektze hassarigim vehaetzim hakketannim hayyotzim al gabbe hassal. hayu hassallim shel temara af al pi shello karat hahutzin mibbifnim mekabbelin tuma shekkach mekayyemin otan. hakkalkala mishsheyyachsom piha veyichrot hahutzim veyigmor et hatteluyot. bet hakkosot vehallaginin af al pi shello karat mibbifnim mekabbelin tuma shekkach mekayyemin otam. hakkenonim hakketannim vehakkelatot mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot hahutzin hayyotzim. hakkenonim haggedolim vehasseyogim haggedolim mishsheyyaase shene dorim larochav shellahen. hannafa vehakkevara vechaf moznayim mishsheyyaase dor echad larochav shellahen. hakuppa mishsheyyaase shete tzefirot larochav shellah. vehaarak mishsheyyaase bo tzefira achat af al pi shello gamar gabbehen mekabbelin tuma shehare niru lema shennaasu vetzurat hakkeli alehen. ha lema ze dome leveged shenneerag miktzato. hammachtzelet mishsheyyichrot hahutzin vezehu gemar melacha. vechol kele hannesarim enan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyitchassemu siftotehen. galme kele etz mekabbelin tuma mishshennaasa hakkeli betzurato. af al pi sheatid letaaro bisrad o lehashevoto bimchoga o leyappoto bammaatzad vechayyotze bemaasim ellu vaadayin hu golem hoil veeno mechussar chakika vahare hishlim chafirato hare ze mekabbel tuma. vechol galme kele etz mekabbelin tuma chutz mishshel eshkeroa sheen hakkeli mimmennu chashuv keli ad sheyyityappe. vekarov beenay shekkele etzem kichle eshkeroa veen galmehen mekabbelin tuma. keli etz sheen alav tzurat keli af al pi shemmishtammeshin bo eno mekabbel tuma. arubbot shel nachtomin shessodrim alehen hachallot keshehen batzek mittammeot shehare tzurat hakkeli alehen. veshel baale battim enan mekabbelin tuma. veim tzevaan besikra o becharkom vechayyotze bahen mittammeot shehare naaset lahen tzurat keli. serod shel nachtomin shennotnin bo hammayim shemmekattefin bo tame veshel baale battim tahor. veim gippefo mearba ruchotav mittamme. nifratz meruach achat tahor. vehalluach sheorchin alav mittamme. keli etz shehassallatim merakkedin alav et hassolet mittamme. veshel baale battim tahor. rachat haggarosot mittammea. shel otzarot tehora shel gittot mittammea veshel goranot tehora. ze hakkelal heasuy lekabbala mekabbel tuma veheasuy lechannes bo tahor: 
Kol hatteloyin tehorin chutz mitteloye nafa shel sallatin uteloy kevarah shel goranot uteloy maggal yad uteloy makkel habballashin mippene shehen mesayyein bishat melacha. ze hakkelal heasuy lesayyeo bishat melacha mittamme litlot bo hakkeli bilvad tahor: 
Nivle hameshorrim mittammein. nivle bene levi shemmezammerin bahen bammikdash tehorin. habbitnon vehanniktemon vehairus mittammein: 
Metzudat hachulda mittamme veshel achbarim tehora lefi sheen lah bet kibbul veen aleha tzurat keli: 
Kotzin sheorgin bahen kemo kefifa shemmannichin bah hatteenim vechayyotze bahen mittammein. vesheorgin bahen ketavnit menora gedola sheotzrin bahen hachittin tehora sheen torat keli aleha: 
Alin shemmesargin otan kemin seyag saviv lapperot tahor. veim asu seyag shel nesarin mittammein: 
Chotel shel hutzin shemmannichin bo harotev vechayyotze bo im hu noten letocho venotel mittocho mittamme veim eno yachol littol ma shebbetocho ad sheyyikraennu o yattirennu o shechashav leechol ma shebbetocho ulezarko tahor. vechen hakkeren shehu mishtammesh bah umashlichah enah mekabbelet tuma. veim chashav aleha mekabbelet tuma: 
Hashshofar eno mekabbel tuma. chatacho lihyot keren tashmish mekabbel tuma: 
Keara shekkevaah beshidda teva umigdal im hi kederech kabbalatah mekabbelet tuma. veim kevaah baddofen shehare enah mekabbelet ad shemmattim shidda al tzidda hare zo mikkelal hashshidda utehora: 
Haakkon veharatov vehakkeluv shel etz tehorin: 
Hammaddaf vehappaltzur umetzudat secharim mittammein shehare tzurat keli alehem: 
Hassafsalin shebbappundekaot veshel melammede tinokot af al pi shehen nekuvin umachnisin bahen et haraglayim tehorim. kavu bahen raglayim bemasmer mekabbelin tuma. ze hakkelal kol shennittal veen raglav nittalot immo tahor. vechol shennittal veraglav nittalot immo tame. veim hayu kullan shel etz o etzem mekabbel tuma. hayta achat meraglav shel even eno mekabbel tuma:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 6:
Kol keli shennitma venishbar achar shennitma venifseda tzurato vetashmisho tahor bishvirato. vechen kelim shennishberu keshehen tehorin shivrehen enan mekabbelin tuma: 
Kamma shiur hashshever sheyyishshaver bichli etz o keli etzem veyihye tahor. kol kele baale battim shiuran berimmonim. ketzad. mishsheyyinnakev hakkeli bemotzi rimmon tahor. veharimmon sheamru benoni lo gadol velo katan, lefi daat haroe. veyihyu bakkeli shelosha rimmonim achuzim ze baze. nikkav hakkeli bemotzi zayit usetamo vechazar venikkav bemotzi zayit usetamo [ad shehishlimo lemotzi] rimmon af al pi shehu satum tahor shehare naasu lo panim chadashot: 
Kelim sheasaan mittechilla nekuvin bemotzi rimmon kegon hassal vehappuchlatz shel gemallim vehaappifyarot mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyikkara rubban: 
Appifyarot sheasa lahen kanim lemala ulematta lechazzek tehorot. asa lahen gappayim kol shehen af al pi shekkullah nekuva kemotzi rimmon mekabbelet tuma: 
Kol hakkelim sheenan yecholin lekabbel rimmonim kegon harova vachatzi rova vehakkenonim hakketannim shiuran bemotzi zayit. nigmemu siftotehen im nishar bahen kede lekabbel kol shehu temein: 
Hassallin shel pat shiuran kechikkarot shel pat: 
Kuppat haggannanim mishshettotzi aguddot shel yarak tehora. veshel baale battim bemotzi teven. shel ballanin bigvava: 
Bet kearot sheeno mekabbel kearot hoil umekabbel hattamchuyin hare ze mekabbel tuma. vechen bet hari sheeno mekabbel mashkin hoil umekabbel et hari hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Kol keli etz shennechlak lishnayim tahor veaf al pi shemmekabbelin al dafnotehen beilpasin. chutz mikkelim shel etz shechetzyan o miktzatan keli bifne atzmo mittechillat asiyyatan kegon hashshulchan hakkaful shemmitchilla naasa shene chalakim vahare hu nichpal venifshat. uchegon hattamchuy hammiznon shehu kearot kearot vahare bechol chelek mechalakav kearot shelemot. uchegon hakkisse hakkaful vechol kayyotze beellu. vechen bet laginin uvet hakkosot shel etz shennifchat echad mehen ze shennifchat tahor veeno chibbur lishar habbattim. nifchat hashsheni tahor veeno chibbur lo. nifchatu shelashtan kullan tehorin. vechen kol kayyotze bechelim kaellu: 
Mashpelet sheemtzaitah gevoha vezaviyyoteha yordot venifchata mitztzad echad temea mippene shehi mekabbelet mitztzad hashsheni. nifchata mitztzad hashsheni tehora. hashshulchan vehaddulpeki shennifchatu mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyechalku veyibbadel kol chelek mechavero. nittela achat meraglehen tehora. vechen im nittela hashsheniyya. nittela hashshelishit im chishshev alehem sheyyochal al shulchan ze o al dulpeki zo kemo ochel betavla mekabbelin tuma veim lav tehorin: 
Kele nesarim shennaflu siftotehen tehorin. veim nishar machsom siftotehen kol shehu mekabbelin tuma: 
Tavla shemmilleah etzim utekaah tehora. chippah binsarim mekabbelet tuma: 
Safsal shennitparek tahor. sirgelo bimshichot o bachavalim mekabbel tuma: 
Hassallim shel gemallim hittiran tehorin chazar ukesharan mekabbelin tuma. nimtzeu mittammein umittaharin afillu eser peamim beyom: 
Hashshulchan o haddulpeki shechippan beshayish veshiyyer bahem mekom hannachat hakkosot mekabbelin tuma veim chippa hakkol tahor. ben betzippuy omed ben betzippuy sheeno omed ben shechippa et levazbezav ben shello chippan ben shehayu shel etzim chashuvim kegon eshkeroa vechayyotze bo ben shehayu shel shear etzim hoil vechippan kullan tehorin kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 7: Kele or meematay mekabbelin tuma. hatturemal vechayyotze bo mishsheyyachsom siftotav veyichrot hakkofin hakketannim hayyotzin al gabbe haor veyaase kichotav. sekuretiya mishsheyyachsom veyichrot veyaase tzitzatah. katavuleya mishsheyyachsom veyichrot. hakkar vehakkeset shel or mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot hakkofin hayyotzin. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. hattefillin mishsheyyigmor hakketzitza af al pi shehu atid latet bah et hartzua mekabbelet tuma. or haarisa shehu atid laasot lo tabbur ad sheyyaasennu lo. hassandal mishsheyyakmia. hamminal misheyyiggov [al] haimmum. veim atid locharkem ulesartet ad sheyyicharkem visartet:

Or sheen alav tzurat keli eno mekabbel tuma. lefichach kaf shel or shekkoshrin lokte kotzim al kappotehen kede shello yakkem kotz eno mekabbel tuma mippene shehu or pashut veen alav tzurat keli. vechen haor shemmelakketin bo gelale habbakar veor shechosmin bo pi habbehema veor shemmoshivin bo haddevorim beshaa shellokchin haddevash veor shemmenifin bo et haruach mippene hachom tehorin veen mekabbelin tuma:
Kol bet haetzbaot shel or tehorot chutz mishshel kayaytzin mippene shehi mekabbelet et haog temea. nikrea im enah mekabbelet et rov haog tehora:
